sentences.zh: 元和七年元和七年春正月辛酉朔，己巳，以刑部尚書趙宗儒檢校吏部尚書、興元尹、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 7 — In spring of Yuanhe 7, first month, xinyou new moon; on jisi Zhao Zongru, Minister of Justice, was made acting Minister of Personnel, Xingyuan intendant, and Shannan West circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 7's first month, on jisi the court made Zhao Zongru acting personnel minister and Shannan West military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以兵部尚書王紹判戶部事。

translations.literal: On gengwu Wang Shao, Minister of War, was assigned to oversee Ministry of Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wang Shao took charge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以京兆尹元義方為鄜州刺史、鄜坊丹延觀察使，以司農卿李銛為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On xinwei Yuan Yifang, Jingzhao intendant, was made Yan prefect and Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan observation commissioner; Li Qian, Minister of Agriculture, was made Jingzhao intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yuan Yifang went to Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan and Li Qian became Jingzhao intendant.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月掩熒惑。

translations.literal: That night the moon occulted Mars.
translations.idiomatic: That night Mars was eclipsed by the moon.

sentences.zh: 壬申，廢信州永豐縣、越州山陰縣、衢州盈川縣。

translations.literal: On renshen Yongfeng county of Xinzhou, Shanyin county of Yuezhou, and Yingchuan county of Quzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen three counties were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，振武河溢，毀東受降城。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Zhenwu River overflowed and destroyed the Eastern Surrender Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a flood wrecked the Eastern Surrender Fort.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅朔。

translations.literal: Second month, gengyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔以去秋旱歉，賑京畿粟三十萬石；

translations.literal: On renchen an edict: because of last autumn's drought and poor harvest, 300,000 shi of grain were to relieve the capital region;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict ordered 300,000 shi of relief grain for the drought-stricken capital.

sentences.zh: 其元和六年春賑貸百姓粟二十四萬石，並宜放免。

translations.literal: the 240,000 shi lent to commoners in spring of Yuanhe 6 were also to be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Spring loans from Yuanhe 6 were forgiven as well.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，尚書省重定左、右僕射上事儀注。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Ministry of State Affairs redetermined the ceremony for vice premiers receiving business.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou rites for vice premiers entering office were revised.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以兵部侍郎許孟容為河南尹。

translations.literal: On renyin Xu Mengrong, Vice Minister of War, was made Henan intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xu Mengrong became Henan intendant.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，山南西道節度使裴玢卒。

translations.literal: On xinhai Pei Bing, military commissioner of Shannan West, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pei Bing died in Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，入蕃使不得與私覿正員官，量別支給以充私覿。

translations.literal: On guichou envoys entering Tibet were forbidden to exchange private gifts with regular officials; separate allotments were to supply private gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Tibet envoys could no longer buy favors from regular officials.

sentences.zh: 舊使絕域者，許賣正員官十餘員，取貨以備私覿，雖優假遠使，殊非典法，故革之。

translations.literal: Formerly envoys to distant regions were allowed to sell more than ten regular official posts to fund private gifts — though it favored distant envoys, it was quite contrary to statute, so it was reformed.
translations.idiomatic: The old practice of selling posts to fund envoys' gifts was abolished as improper.

sentences.zh: 敕：「錢重物輕，為弊頗甚，詳求適變，將以便人。

translations.literal: An edict: "Money is heavy and goods light — the harm is considerable; seek suitable changes to convenience the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on currency reform began:

sentences.zh: 所貴緡貨通行，裏閭寬恤。

translations.literal: What is prized is that currency circulate and villages be eased."
translations.idiomatic: "Let cash circulate and ease the countryside."

sentences.zh: 宜令群臣各隨所見利害狀以聞。

translations.literal: Let all officials submit memorials on benefits and harms as each sees them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to report remedies.
Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 三月己未。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei.
translations.idiomatic: The third month reached jiwei.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以惠昭太子葬，罷曲江上巳宴。

translations.literal: On xinyou, because of Crown Prince Huizhao's funeral, the Qujiang shangsi banquet was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Qujiang spring banquet was cancelled for the crown prince's funeral.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以旱，敕諸司疏決系囚。

translations.literal: On gengwu, because of drought, an edict ordered all offices to review and release prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu drought amnesty reviews were ordered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened on wuzi.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，敕天下州府民戶，每田畝，種桑二樹，長吏逐年檢計以聞。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict ordered every prefecture household to plant two mulberry trees per mu of field; chief officials were to inspect yearly and report.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court mandated mulberry planting and annual inspection.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鹽鐵使王播奏元和六年賣鹽鐵，除峽內井鹽外，計收六百八十五萬九千二百貫。

translations.literal: On xinhai Salt and Iron Commissioner Wang Bo reported Yuanhe 6 salt and iron sales, except gorge well salt, totaled 6,859,200 strings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wang Bo reported 6.86 million strings in salt and iron revenue.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上謂宰臣曰：「卿等累言吳越去年水旱，昨有御史自江淮回，言不至為災，人非甚困。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Emperor said to the chief ministers: "You have repeatedly said Wu-Yue suffered flood and drought last year; yesterday a censor returned from Jiang-Huai and said the disaster was not so severe and the people were not very distressed."
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the emperor challenged reports that Wu-Yue had suffered severe flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 」李絳對曰：「臣得兩浙、淮南狀，繼言歉旱。

translations.literal: Li Jiang replied: "I have received reports from the two Zhe and Huainan circuits stating successive drought and poor harvest."
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang countered that Zhe and Huainan reports still showed drought.

sentences.zh: 方隅授任，皆朝廷信重之臣。

translations.literal: Regional appointees are all ministers the court trusts heavily.
translations.idiomatic: Those regional commanders are men the throne trusts.

sentences.zh: 御史非良，或容希媚，此正當奸佞之臣。

translations.literal: If the censor is not good, he may flatter — this is precisely the treacherous sort of minister.
translations.idiomatic: A bad censor flatters; that is the face of treachery.

sentences.zh: 況推誠之道，君人大本，任大臣以事，不可以小臣言間之。

translations.literal: Moreover, sincerity in delegating authority is the ruler's foundation; entrust great ministers with affairs — small men's words must not come between.
translations.idiomatic: Delegation to great ministers must not be undermined by petty informers.

sentences.zh: 伏望明示御史姓名，正之典刑。

translations.literal: I beg you clearly name the censor and punish him by statute.
translations.idiomatic: Name the censor and punish him under law.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「卿言是也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Your words are correct."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 朝廷大體，以恤人為本，一方不稔，即宜賑救，濟其饑寒，況可疑之也！

translations.literal: "The court's great principle is caring for the people; if one region fails to harvest, relief must be given for hunger and cold — how could it be doubted!
translations.idiomatic: "The throne exists to succor the people; one failed harvest demands relief — never doubt it!

sentences.zh: 向者不思而有此問，朕言過矣。

translations.literal: Formerly I did not think and made this inquiry — my words went too far."
translations.idiomatic: I spoke rashly in questioning it."

sentences.zh: 」絳等拜賀。

translations.literal: Jiang and the others bowed in congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang and the others bowed in thanks.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，熒惑近太微右執法。

translations.literal: On guihai Mars drew near the Right Enforcement star of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Mars neared the Supreme Palace's Right Enforcement star.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，舒州桐城梅天陂內，有黃白二龍，自陂中乘風雷躍起，高二百尺，行六里，入浮塘陂。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dinghai new moon — within Meitian Pool at Tongcheng, Shuzhou, yellow and white dragons rose from the pool on wind and thunder, two hundred chi high, traveled six li, and entered Futang Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month dragons were reported rising from a Shuzhou pool and crossing six li.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以金紫光錄大夫、守司徒、同平章事、崇文館大學士，太清宮使、上柱國、岐國公杜佑為光祿大夫，守太保致仕，宜朝朔望，佑累表懇請故也。

translations.literal: On guisi Du You, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Grand Councillor, Chongwen Hall academician, Taqing Palace commissioner, Pillar of State, Duke of Qi, was made Grand Master of Glory and acting Senior Tutor with retirement, to attend court on the first and fifteenth — because You had repeatedly petitioned earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Du You was finally allowed to retire as Senior Tutor with twice-monthly audience.

sentences.zh: 己亥，月近南斗魁第四星。

translations.literal: On jihai the moon drew near the fourth star of the Southern Dipper handle.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the moon neared the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 鎮州甲仗庫一十三間災，兵仗都盡。

translations.literal: Thirteen rooms of the Zhenzhou armory burned; all weapons were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzhou's armory burned and its stores were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 王承宗常蓄叛謀，至是始懼天罰，兇氣稍奪，仍殺主庫吏百餘人。

translations.literal: Wang Chengzong often harbored rebellion; now he began to fear heaven's punishment, his fierce spirit was somewhat subdued, yet he still killed more than a hundred chief storehouse clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong, long rebellious, feared divine punishment and massacred his armory clerks.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以兵部員外郎王涯知制誥。

translations.literal: On yichou Wang Ya, Vice Minister of War, was made edict drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang Ya joined the drafting office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，制立遂王宥為皇太了，改名恆。

translations.literal: On yihai a decree installed Prince Sui You as crown prince and renamed him Heng.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Prince You became crown prince Heng.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以新羅大宰相金彥升為開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、使持節、大都督雞林州諸軍事、雞林州刺史，兼寧海軍使、上柱國，封新羅國王；

translations.literal: On jimao Silla's grand chancellor Kim Eom-seung was made Acting Grand Master of the Palace, acting Grand Preceptor, commissioner with credentials, Grand Protector General of Gyerim prefecture and its armies, Gyerim prefect, concurrent Ninghai army commissioner, Pillar of State, and enfeoffed King of Silla;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Kim Eom-seung was enfeoffed King of Silla with full ceremonial rank.

sentences.zh: 仍冊彥升妻貞氏為妃。

translations.literal: his wife Lady Jeong was also enfeoffed as royal consort.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Jeong was named his royal consort.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥朔，新除新羅國大宰相金崇斌等三人，宜令本國準例賜戟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dinghai new moon — the three newly appointed Silla grand chancellors including Jin Chong-bin were to be granted halberds per their state's precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month three new Silla envoys received halberds by precedent.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，魏博節度使田季安卒。

translations.literal: On wuxu Tian Ji'an, military commissioner of Weibo, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Tian Ji'an of Weibo died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，廢蓬州宕渠縣。

translations.literal: On xinchou Dangqu county of Pengzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Dangqu county was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宣歙觀察使房式卒。

translations.literal: On jiachen Fang Shi, Xuanshe observation commissioner, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Fang Shi died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以蘇州刺史範傳正為宣歙觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Fan Chuanzheng, Suzhou prefect, was made Xuanshe observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Fan Chuanzheng took Xuanshe.

sentences.zh: 戊申，制：「諸州府五品已上官替後，委本道長官量其才行、官業、資歷，每年冬季一度聞薦。

translations.literal: On wushen a decree: "After officials of fifth rank and above leave office in prefectures, the circuit chief shall weigh talent, service record, and seniority and once each winter submit recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: A decree required annual winter recommendations for outgoing prefectural officials of fifth rank and above.

sentences.zh: 其罷使郎官、御史，許朝臣每年冬季準此聞薦，諸使府參佐、檢校官，從元授官月日計，如是五品已上官及臺省官，經三十個月外，任與轉改；

translations.literal: Dismissed capital commissioners and censors — court officials may each winter recommend under this rule; staff of commissioner offices and acting officials count from the original appointment month; if fifth rank and above or capital office, after thirty months they may be transferred;
translations.idiomatic: Capital commissioners and censorial staff were included; fifth-rank and capital posts could transfer after thirty months;

sentences.zh: 餘官經三十六個月奏轉改。

translations.literal: other offices memorialize for transfer after thirty-six months.
translations.idiomatic: other offices after thirty-six.

sentences.zh: 如未經考便有事故及停替官，本限之外更加十個月，即任申奏。

translations.literal: If before examination there is an incident or removal, ten months beyond the base limit are added, then memorialization is permitted."
translations.idiomatic: Incidents before review added ten months to the term. Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，以左龍武大將軍薛平為滑州刺史、義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Xue Ping, Left Dragon Martial Grand General, was made Hua prefect and Yicheng army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xue Ping became Yicheng military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，魏博三軍舉其衙將田興知軍州事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yimou — the three armies of Weibo elevated their guard officer Tian Xing to manage the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Weibo's troops installed Tian Xing.

sentences.zh: 時田季安死，子懷諫年十一，為副大使、知軍府事，軍政一決於家僮蔣士則，數易大將，軍情不安。

translations.literal: When Tian Ji'an died, his son Huaijian was eleven, serving as vice ambassador managing the military government; all policy rested with the household steward Jiang Shize, who repeatedly replaced major generals, and army morale was unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: After Tian Ji'an's death his eleven-year-old son ruled in name while Jiang Shize manipulated the army.

sentences.zh: 因田興入衙，兵環而劫請，興頓僕於地，軍眾不散。

translations.literal: When Tian Xing entered the yamen, soldiers surrounded him and compelled him; Xing fell prostrate to the ground, yet the crowd would not disperse.
translations.idiomatic: Troops surrounded Tian Xing and forced him prostrate before they would listen.

sentences.zh: 興曰：「欲聽吾命，勿犯副大使。

translations.literal: Xing said: "If you wish to heed my command, do not harm the vice ambassador."
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xing said they must spare the boy vice ambassador.

sentences.zh: 」眾曰：「諾。

translations.literal: The crowd said: "Agreed."
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers assented.

sentences.zh: 」但殺蔣士則等十數人而止。

translations.literal: They only killed Jiang Shize and about ten others, then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: They killed Jiang Shize and a dozen confederates.

sentences.zh: 即日移懷諫於外，令朝京師。

translations.literal: That day Huaijian was moved outside and ordered to proceed to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Huaijian was sent to Chang'an the same day.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以魏博都知兵馬使、兼御史中丞、沂國公田興為銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書，兼魏州大都督府長史，充魏博節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Tian Xing, Weibo director of military affairs, concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, Duke of Yi, was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Minister of Works, concurrent Administrator of Wei prefecture, and Weibo military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Tian Xing was formally made Weibo military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，澧王寬改名惲，深王察改名忭，洋王寰改名忻，絳王寮改名悟，建王審改名恪。

translations.literal: On gengxu Prince Li of Li was renamed Yun; Prince Shen of Shen was renamed Bian; Prince Yang of Yang was renamed Xin; Prince Jiang of Jiang was renamed Wu; Prince Jian of Jian was renamed Ke.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu five princes received new taboo names.

sentences.zh: 以鄭滑節度使袁滋為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Yuan Zi, Zheng-Hua military commissioner, was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔：「田興以魏博請命，宜令司封郎中、知制誥裴度往彼宣慰，賜三軍賞錢一百五十萬貫，以河陰院諸道合進內庫物充。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict: "Tian Xing has requested imperial command for Weibo — Fengfenglang drafting commissioner Pei Du shall go there to proclaim comfort and grant the three armies a reward of 1,500,000 strings, supplied from He-yin compound tributes of all circuits to the inner treasury."
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Pei Du was sent to Weibo with 1.5 million strings to reward the armies.

sentences.zh: 六州諸縣宣達朝旨。

translations.literal: The six prefectures and counties were to proclaim the court's decree.
translations.idiomatic: Six prefectures were to broadcast the decree.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太保致仕杜祐卒。

translations.literal: On xinwei retired Senior Tutor Du You died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Du You died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 東川觀察使潘孟陽奏龍州武安縣嘉禾生，有麟食之。

translations.literal: Dongchuan observation commissioner Pan Mengyang memorialized that at Wuan, Longzhou, auspicious grain grew and a qilin ate it.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mengyang reported a qilin eating auspicious grain in Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 麟食來，群鹿環之，光彩不可正視。

translations.literal: When the qilin came, deer surrounded it; its radiance could not be looked at directly.
translations.idiomatic: Deer ringed the beast in blinding light.

sentences.zh: 使畫工圖之以獻。

translations.literal: He sent a painter to depict it and present the picture.
translations.idiomatic: A painting was sent to court.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以給事中李逢吉、司勛員外郎李巨並充皇太子諸王侍讀。

translations.literal: On yihai Li Fengji, supervising secretary, and Li Ju, Bureau of Merit vice director, were both made readers for the crown prince and princes.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Fengji and Li Ju became tutors to the heir and princes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，吏部尚書鄭餘慶請復置吏部考官三員，吏部郎中楊於陵執奏以為不便。

translations.literal: On wuyin Minister of Personnel Zheng Yuqing requested restoration of three Ministry examiners; Bureau of Personnel director Yang Yuling memorialized that it was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zheng Yuqing sought three examiners; Yang Yuling objected.

sentences.zh: 乃詔考官韋顗等三人祇考及第科目人，其餘吏部侍郎自定，己卯，江西觀察使崔芃卒。

translations.literal: Then an edict: examiners Wei Yi and two others were only to examine passed candidates; the rest the Vice Minister of Personnel would decide. On jimao Jiangxi observation commissioner Cui Pang died.
translations.idiomatic: Examiners were limited to passers; on jimao Cui Pang died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳前魏情節度副使田懷諫為右監門衛將軍，賜宅一區、芻粟等。

translations.literal: On xinsi former Weibo vice commissioner Tian Huaijian was made Right Supervisor of the Gate Guard, granted one residence and fodder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Tian Huaijian was honored at court with a house and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以同州刺史裴堪為江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Pei Kan, Tong prefect, was made Jiangxi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Pei Kan took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，以吏部尚書鄭餘慶為太子少傅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingxu new moon — Zheng Yuqing, Minister of Personnel, was made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened with Zheng Yuqing made crown prince tutor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，左拾遺楊歸厚以自娶婦，進狀借禮會院，貶國子主簿分司。

translations.literal: On bingchen Left Reminder Yang Guihou, for borrowing the ceremonial compound for his own wedding, submitted a request and was demoted to National University registrar in residence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yang Guihou was demoted for hijacking the ritual hall for his wedding.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以京兆尹裴向為同州防禦使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Pei Xiang, Jingzhao intendant, was made Tongzhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Pei Xiang went to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，魏博奏管內州縣官員二百五十三員，請吏部銓注。

translations.literal: On jihai Weibo memorialized 253 officials in the circuit and requested Ministry assignment.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Weibo asked the Ministry to fill 253 posts.

sentences.zh: 元和八年八年春正月乙卯朔。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 8 — In spring of Yuanhe 8, first month, yimao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 8 opened on yimao.

sentences.zh: 庚午，冊大言義為渤海國王，授秘書監、忽汗州都督。

translations.literal: On gengwu Dayan Yi was enfeoffed King of Bo Hai and appointed Secretariat supervisor and Hehanzhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Dayan Yi became King of Bo Hai.

sentences.zh: 辛未，制以正議大夫、守禮部尚書、同平章事、上柱國、扶風郡開國公權德輿守禮部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On xinwei a decree made Quan Deyu, Proper Counsel Grand Master, acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Grand Councillor, Pillar of State, Duke of Fufeng, continue as Minister of Rites and cease concurrent governance.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Quan Deyu left the Secretariat but kept Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以山南東道節度使李夷簡檢校戶部尚書、成都尹，充劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: On guiwei Li Yijian, Shannan East military commissioner, was made acting Minister of Revenue, Chengdu intendant, and Xichuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Yijian went to Xichuan.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書袁滋檢校兵部尚書、襄州刺史，充山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Yuan Zi, Minister of Revenue, was made acting Minister of War, Xiang prefect, and Shannan East military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi took Shannan East.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉朔。

translations.literal: Second month, yiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on yiyou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，田興改名弘正。

translations.literal: On xinmao Tian Xing was renamed Hongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Tian Xing received the name Hongzheng.

sentences.zh: 宰相李吉甫進所撰《元和郡國圖》三十卷，又進《六代略》三十卷，又為《十道州郡圖》五十四卷。

translations.literal: Chief minister Li Jifu presented his compiled Yuanhe Commanderies Atlas in thirty scrolls, also presented Six Dynasties Summary in thirty scrolls, and also made Ten Circuits Prefecture Atlas in fifty-four scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jifu presented three geographical works to the throne.

sentences.zh: 宰相于頔男太常丞敏專殺梁正言奴，棄溷中。

translations.literal: Chief minister Yu Di's son Sensitive, Grand Director of the Imperial Clan, killed Liang Zhengyan's slave and threw the body in the privy.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Di's son Yu Min murdered a slave and hid the corpse.

sentences.zh: 事發，頔與男季友素服待罪。

translations.literal: When the affair broke out, Yu Di and his son Jiyou wore plain clothes and awaited punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Di and Jiyou waited in mourning dress for judgment.

sentences.zh: 貶頔恩王傅。

translations.literal: Yu Di was demoted to tutor of the Prince of En.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Di was demoted to Prince En's tutor.

sentences.zh: 於敏長流雷州，錮身發遣。

translations.literal: Yu Min was exiled far to Leizhou, body in fetters, and dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Min was exiled to Leizhou in chains.

sentences.zh: 殿中少監、駙馬都尉於季友誑罔公主，藏隱內人，轉授兇兄，移貯外舍，傷風黷禮，莫大於茲，宜削奪所任官，令在家修省。

translations.literal: Palace Vice Director and Commandant of Escorts Yu Jiyou deceived the princess, concealed palace women, transferred them to a violent elder brother, and stored them in an outer lodge — no greater breach of ritual; all his offices were to be stripped and he was to remain home in reflection.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jiyou was stripped of office for hiding palace women and abetting his brother.

sentences.zh: 贊善大夫於正、秘書丞於方並停見任，皆頔祿之子也。

translations.literal: Companions Yu Zheng and Secretariat Director Yu Fang were both suspended from current posts — all were Yu Di's sons on stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Two more sons on Yu Di's stipend were suspended.

sentences.zh: 捕獲受于頔賂為致出鎮人梁正言，及交構權貴僧鑒虛，並付京兆府杖死。

translations.literal: Liang Zhengyan, who had taken Yu Di's bribes to secure a posting out, and the monk Jianxu, who colluded with powerholders, were both handed to the Jingzhao office and beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Briber Liang Zhengyan and monk Jianxu were beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以劍南西川節度使、銀青光祿大夫、檢校吏部尚書、兼門下侍郎、同平章事、上柱國、臨淮郡開國公、食邑二千戶武元衡復入中書知政事，兼崇玄館大學士、太清宮使。

translations.literal: On jiazi Wu Yuanheng, Xichuan military commissioner, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Minister of Personnel, concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, Pillar of State, Duke of Huaihai with a fief of two thousand households, re-entered the Secretariat to manage governance, and was also Chongxuan Hall academician and Taqing Palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wu Yuanheng returned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上以久旱，親於禁中求雨，是夜，澍雨沾足。

translations.literal: On xinwei, because of long drought, the Emperor personally sought rain within the forbidden quarters; that night timely rain soaked enough.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor prayed in the palace and rain followed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大風壞崇陵寢殿鴟尾，折門戟六。

translations.literal: On bingzi a great wind broke the owl-tail of Chongling's mausoleum hall and broke six gate halberds.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a storm damaged Chongling and broke six gate halberds.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened on guiwei.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以邕管經略使房啟為桂管觀察使，以開州刺史竇群為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On yiyou Fang Qi, Yong-Guan pacification commissioner, was made Gui observation commissioner; Dou Qun, Kai prefect, was made Yong-Guan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Fang Qi took Gui and Dou Qun took Yong-Guan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以錢重貨輕，出庫錢五十萬貫，令兩常平倉收市布帛，每段匹於舊估加十之一。

translations.literal: On bingxu, because money was heavy and goods light, 500,000 strings were taken from the treasury and the two Ever-Normal granaries were ordered to buy cloth and silk; each bolt was marked up one-tenth above the old valuation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the court spent 500,000 strings to buy cloth and stabilize prices.

sentences.zh: 鄜坊觀察使元義方卒，辛卯，以將作監薛伾為鄜坊觀察使。

translations.literal: Yan-Fang observation commissioner Yuan Yifang died; on xinmao Xue Bei was made Yan-Fang observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yifang died; Xue Bei succeeded him in Yan-Fang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，長安西市豕生三耳八足二尾。

translations.literal: On yiwei a pig in Chang'an's western market bore three ears, eight legs, and two tails.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei a monstrous pig was reported in the western market.

sentences.zh: 僧鑒虛為高崇文納賂四萬五千貫與宰相杜黃裳，共引致人永樂縣仿吳憑，付錢與黃裳男載。

translations.literal: Monk Jianxu took a bribe of forty-five thousand strings from Gao Chongwen for Grand Councillor Du Huangchang, jointly introducing the man Wu Ping of Yongle county; payment was given to Huangchang's son Zai.
translations.idiomatic: Monk Jianxu bribed Du Huangchang through Gao Chongwen's forty-five thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 敕吳賃配流昭州，黃裳、崇文已薨歿，所用錢不須勘問，杜載釋放。

translations.literal: An edict exiled Wu Ping to Zhaozhou; Huangchang and Chongwen were already dead, so the money used was not to be investigated, and Du Zai was released.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ping was exiled; the dead men's bribes went uninvestigated and Du Zai was freed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜魏博田弘正錢二十萬貫，收市軍糧。

translations.literal: On xinhai Weibo's Tian Hongzheng was granted 200,000 strings to buy army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Tian Hongzheng received 200,000 strings for grain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河中尹張弘靖奏修古舜城。

translations.literal: On gengshen Hedong intendant Zhang Hongjing memorialized repair of the ancient Shun city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Hongjing proposed restoring ancient Shun city.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinsi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on xinsi.

sentences.zh: 時積雨，延英不開十五日。

translations.literal: Rain had accumulated; Yanying Hall did not open for fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains kept the emperor from Yanying audiences for fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 是日，上謂宰臣曰：「今後每三日，雨亦對來。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor said to the chief ministers: "Hereafter, every three days, come for audience even if it rains."
translations.idiomatic: That day he ordered ministers to attend every three days regardless of rain.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，工部尚書致仕裴佶卒。

translations.literal: On yiyou retired Minister of Works Pei Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Pei Ji died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以東都留守韓皋檢校吏部尚書，兼許州刺史，充忠武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Han Gao, Eastern Capital guardian, was made acting Minister of Personnel, concurrent Xu prefect, and Zhongwu army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Han Gao took Zhongwu with acting personnel rank.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，京師大風雨，毀屋飄瓦，人多壓死。

translations.literal: On gengyin the capital suffered great wind and rain; houses were destroyed and tiles blown away; many people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin a capital storm killed many under collapsed roofs.

sentences.zh: 所在川瀆暴漲，行人不通。

translations.literal: Everywhere rivers and streams swelled violently; travelers could not pass.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded roads halted travel across the region.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，出宮人二百車，任從所適，以水災故也。

translations.literal: On xinchou two hundred cartloads of palace women were released to go where they wished, because of the flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou two hundred cartloads of palace women were freed after the floods.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宰臣武元衡李吉甫李絳、舊相鄭餘慶權德輿各奉詔令進舊詩。

translations.literal: On renyin chief ministers Wu Yuanheng, Li Jifu, and Li Jiang, and former ministers Zheng Yuqing and Quan Deyu each received an edict to present old poems.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the emperor ordered several ministers to submit old poems.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinhai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on xinhai.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以權德輿檢校吏部尚書、東都留守。

translations.literal: On guichou Quan Deyu was made acting Minister of Personnel and Eastern Capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Quan Deyu became Luoyang guardian with personnel rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以振武節度使李光進為靈州大都督府長史、靈武節度使。

translations.literal: On dingmao Li Guangjin, Zhenwu military commissioner, was made Administrator of Ling prefecture and Lingwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Guangjin took Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命中尉彭中獻修興唐觀，壯其規制，北拒禁城，開復道以通行幸。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Emperor ordered Palace Commander Peng Zhongxian to repair Xingtang Abbey; its layout was grand; north it faced the forbidden city; a restored passage was opened for imperial processions.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Peng Zhongxian rebuilt Xingtang Abbey with a passage to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月近五諸侯。

translations.literal: That night the moon drew near the Five Feudatories.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon neared the Five Feudatories.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，新授桂管觀察使房啟降為太僕少卿。

translations.literal: On dingchou newly appointed Gui observation commissioner Fang Qi was demoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Fang Qi was demoted from Gui.

sentences.zh: 啟初拜桂管，啟吏賂吏部主者，私得官告以授啟。

translations.literal: When Qi first received Gui, Qi's clerk bribed the Ministry clerk in charge and privately obtained the commission document to give Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Qi's clerk had bribed the Ministry for an early commission.

sentences.zh: 俄有詔命中使齎告牒與啟，曰：「受之五日矣。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered a palace envoy to deliver the patent to Qi, saying: "You have held it five days already."
translations.idiomatic: The throne then sent the real patent: Qi had held a forged one for five days.

sentences.zh: 」上怒，杖吏部令史，罰郎官，啟亦即降之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was angry, caned the Ministry clerks, fined the bureau directors, and Qi was immediately demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor punished the Ministry and demoted Qi.

sentences.zh: 以安南都護馬總為桂管觀察使，以江州刺史張勔為安南都護、本管經略招討使。

translations.literal: Ma Zong, Protector-General of Annan, was made Gui observation commissioner; Zhang Kan, Jiang prefect, was made Protector-General of Annan and pacification commissioner of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zong took Gui; Zhang Kan took Annan.

sentences.zh: 鄜坊觀察使薛伾卒。

translations.literal: Yan-Fang observation commissioner Xue Bei died.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Bei died in Yan-Fang.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinsi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on xinsi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以蘄州刺史裴行立為安南都護、本管經略招討使，以張勔耄年也。

translations.literal: On guiwei Pei Xingli, Qi prefect, was made Protector-General of Annan and pacification commissioner of the circuit, because Zhang Kan was aged.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Pei Xingli replaced the aged Zhang Kan in Annan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以司農卿裴武為鄜坊觀察使。

translations.literal: On dinghai Pei Wu, Minister of Agriculture, was made Yan-Fang observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Pei Wu took Yan-Fang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔毀家徇國故徐州刺史李洧等一十家子孫，並宜甄獎。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict: the descendants of the ten families who destroyed their households to serve the state, such as former Xuzhou prefect Li Wei, were all to be selected and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu descendants of loyal martyrs were ordered rewarded.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白近軒轅。

translations.literal: On jiawu Venus drew near the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Venus neared the Chariot constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以東川節度使潘孟陽為戶部侍郎、判度支，盧坦為梓州刺史、劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Pan Mengyang, Dongchuan military commissioner, was made Vice Minister of Revenue overseeing fiscal affairs; Lu Tan was made Zi prefect and Dongchuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Pan Mengyang entered revenue; Lu Tan took Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廢天武軍，並入神策軍。

translations.literal: On yisi the Heavenly Martial Army was abolished and merged into the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Heavenly Martial Army was absorbed into the Divine Strategy.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，淄青李師道進鶻十二，命還之。

translations.literal: On bingchen Li Shidao of Ziqing presented twelve hawks; an order returned them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Shidao's hawks were sent back.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜群臣宴於曲江。

translations.literal: On wuwu the court granted the ministers a banquet at Qujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court feasted ministers at Qujiang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔：「比聞嶺南五管並福建、黔中等道，多以南口餉遺，及於諸處博易，骨肉離析，良賤難分。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict: "We have heard that the five Guangnan circuits and Fujian, Qianzhong, and similar routes often feed people from the south as gifts and trade them everywhere, tearing families apart and blurring free and bond."
translations.idiomatic: An edict condemned selling southern people as gifts across Lingnan and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 此後嚴加禁止，如違，長吏必當科罰。

translations.literal: Hereafter this is strictly forbidden; violators' chief officials will certainly be punished."
translations.idiomatic: Violators' superiors would be punished. Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」淮西吳少陽獻馬三百匹。

translations.literal: Huaixi's Wu Shaoyang presented three hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoyang of Huaixi sent three hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔：「減死戍邊，前代美政，量其遠邇，亦有便宜。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict: "Commuting death to frontier service was a fine policy of former ages; measuring distance, there are also conveniences."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict praised commuting death to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 今後兩京、關內、河南、河東、河北、淮南、山南東西道州府，除大闢罪外，輕犯不得配流天德五城。

translations.literal: Hereafter in the two capitals, Guannei, Henan, Hedong, Hebei, Huainan, and Shannan East and West circuits, except for great felonies, light offenders may not be exiled to the Tiantede Five Cities."
translations.idiomatic: Light crimes in the heartland could no longer be exiled to the far northwest garrisons.

sentences.zh: ，」戊辰，以給事中竇易直為陜虢防禦使，仍賜金紫。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. On wuchen Remonstrance-and-Admonition Gentleman Dou Yizhi was made Shan-Guo defense commissioner and granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict; on wuchen Dou Yizhi took Shan-Guo with gold-purple rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以恩王傅于頔為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On wuchen Dou Yizhi, supervising secretary, was made Shan-Guo defense commissioner and was also granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Dou Yizhi took Shan-Guo with gold-purple rank.

sentences.zh: 以前朔方靈鹽節度使王佖為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: On renshen Yu Di, tutor of the Prince of En, was made Crown Prince Guest.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yu Di became crown prince guest.

sentences.zh: 將相出入，翰林草制，謂之白麻。

translations.literal: Former Shuofang Ling-Salt military commissioner Wang Bi was made Right Guard general.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bi became Right Guard general.

sentences.zh: 至佖，奏罷中書草制，因為例也。

translations.literal: When ministers and generals entered or left office, the Hanlin drafted the commission — called white hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin white-hemp drafts had marked ministerial commissions.

sentences.zh: 太常習樂，始復用大鼓。

translations.literal: When it reached Wang Bi, he memorialized to end Secretariat drafting, and it became precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bi ended Secretariat drafting of such commissions, establishing precedent.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰朔。

translations.literal: The Imperial Ancestral Temple resumed use of the great drum in practice music.
translations.idiomatic: Court music again used the great drum.

sentences.zh: 己丑，熒惑近太微西垣南首星。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth month opened on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以湖南觀察使柳公綽為嶽、鄂、沔、蘄、安、黃觀察使。

translations.literal: On jichou Mars drew near the southern head star of the Supreme Palace's western rampart.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Mars neared the Supreme Palace rampart.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，涇原節度使硃忠亮卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin Liu Gongchuo, Hunan observation commissioner, was made Yue-E-Min-Qi-An-Huang observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Gongchuo took the middle Yangzi circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，汴州韓弘進所撰《聖朝萬歲樂譜》，共三百首。

translations.literal: On xinmao Zhu Zhongliang, Jingyuan military commissioner, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhu Zhongliang died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以宗正少卿李道古為黔中觀察使，以蘇州刺史張正甫為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On renchen Han Hong of Bianzhou presented his compiled Sacred Dynasty Ten-Thousand Years Music Score, three hundred pieces in all.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Han Hong presented three hundred court music pieces.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以大雪放朝，人有凍踣者，雀鼠多死。

translations.literal: On jisi Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Li Daogu was made Qianzhong observation commissioner; Zhang Zhengfu, Suzhou prefect, was made Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Daogu took Qianzhong and Zhang Zhengfu took Hunan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以神策普潤鎮使蘇光榮為涇州刺史、四鎮北庭行軍涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu heavy snow cancelled court; some people froze and fell; sparrows and mice died in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu snow closed court and killed birds and people.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、司封員外郎韋弘景守本官，以草光榮詔漏敘功勛故也。

translations.literal: On wuxu Su Guangrong, Pujun town commissioner of the Divine Strategy, was made Jing prefect and Four Garrisons Northern March Jingyuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Su Guangrong took Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，振武奏回紇千騎至鷿鵜泉。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and Bureau of Appointments Vice Director Wei Hongjing kept his original office — for drafting Su Guangrong's commission and omitting narration of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Hongjing kept his post despite omitting Su Guangrong's merits in the draft.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌朔。

translations.literal: On renchen Zhenwu reported a thousand Uyghur horsemen reached Pelican Spring.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zhenwu reported a thousand Uyghur riders at Pelican Spring.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以福建觀察使裴次元為河南尹。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以鹽州隸夏州。

translations.literal: On bingchen Pei Ciyuan, Fujian observation commissioner, was made Henan intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Pei Ciyuan became Henan intendant.

sentences.zh: 自夏州至豐州，初置八驛。

translations.literal: On bingyin Yanzhou was placed under Xiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yanzhou was subordinated to Xia.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以泗州刺史薛謇為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingmao Xue Qian, Si prefect, was made Fujian observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xue Qian took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 右龍武統軍劉昌裔卒。

translations.literal: Right Dragon Martial commander-in-chief Liu Changyi died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Changyi died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，昭義郗士美奏諸軍就食於臨洺。

translations.literal: On guiyou Zhaoyi's Xi Shimei memorialized that all armies drew rations at Linming.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Xi Shimei reported armies feeding at Linming.

sentences.zh: 京畿水、旱、霜，損田三萬八千頃。

translations.literal: In the capital region water, drought, and frost damaged 38,000 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region lost 38,000 qing to flood, drought, and frost.

sentences.zh: 十二庚辰朔，以京兆尹李銛為鄜坊觀察使，以代裴武入為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengchen new moon — Li Qian, Jingzhao intendant, was made Yan-Fang observation commissioner; Pei Wu entered as Jingzhao intendant in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qian went to Yan-Fang; Pei Wu became Jingzhao intendant.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕：「應賜王公、公主、百官等莊宅、碾磑、店鋪、車坊、園林等，一任貼典貨賣，其所緣稅役，便令府縣收管。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict: "Estates, mills, shops, carriage yards, and gardens granted to princes, princesses, and officials may be pawned or sold; their tax levies shall then be collected by prefecture and county."
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi granted estates and shops could be sold and taxes routed to local government.

sentences.zh: 」敕：「張茂昭立功河朔，舉族歸朝，義烈之風，史冊收載。

translations.literal: An edict: "Zhang Maozhao of Hebei stood loyal, brought his clan to court, and his righteous valor is recorded in history."
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Zhang Maozhao's Hebei loyalty.

sentences.zh: 如聞身歿之後，家無餘財，追懷舊勛，特越常典，宜歲賜絹二千匹，春秋二時支給。

translations.literal: We hear that after his death his household had no surplus wealth; recalling his old merit, a special exception is made — yearly grant of two thousand bolts of silk, paid spring and autumn."
translations.idiomatic: His heirs were granted two thousand bolts of silk yearly in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 」群臣上表，請立德妃郭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: The ministers submitted a memorial requesting that Virtuous Consort Guo be established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers petitioned to make Virtuous Consort Guo empress.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以桂官觀察使馬總為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使，以邕管經略使崔詠為桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Ma Zong, Gui observation commissioner, was made Guang prefect and Lingnan military commissioner; Yong-Guan pacification commissioner Cui Yong was made Gui observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Ma Zong took Lingnan and Cui Yong took Gui.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以夔州刺史馬平陽為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Ma Pingyang, Qi prefect, was made Yong-Guan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Ma Pingyang took Yong-Guan.

sentences.zh: 振武軍亂，逐其帥李進賢，屠其家。

translations.literal: Zhenwu army mutinied, drove out its commander Li Jinxian, and slaughtered his household.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenwu mutinied, expelling Li Jinxian and killing his family.

sentences.zh: 乃以夏州節度使張煦代進賢，率兵二千赴鎮，許便宜擊斷。

translations.literal: Then Xia military commissioner Zhang Xu replaced Jinxian, leading two thousand troops to the post, with authority to strike and execute as expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xu was sent with two thousand men and discretionary power to punish.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以金吾衛將軍田進為夏州刺史、夏綏銀節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Tian Jin, Golden Guard general, was made Xia prefect and Xia-Sui-Yin military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Tian Jin took Xia-Sui-Yin.

sentences.zh: 以河溢浸滑州羊馬城之半，滑州薛平、魏博田弘正征役萬人，於黎陽界開古黃河道南北長十四里，東西闊六十步，深一丈七尺，決舊河水勢，滑人遂無水患。

translations.literal: Because the Yellow River overflowed and flooded half of Hua prefecture's Sheep-Horse City, Xue Ping of Hua and Tian Hongzheng of Weibo conscripted ten thousand laborers at the Liyang border to open the ancient Yellow River channel — fourteen li north-south, sixty paces east-west wide, one zhang seven chi deep — diverting the old current; the people of Hua were thereafter without flood harm.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Hua were eased when Ping and Hongzheng reopened an ancient Yellow River channel.

sentences.zh: 元和九年九年春正月己酉朔。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 9 — In spring of Yuanhe 9, first month, jiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 9 opened on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大霧而雪。

translations.literal: On yimao great fog and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao fog and snow blanketed the capital.

sentences.zh: 李吉甫累表辭相位，不許。

translations.literal: Li Jifu repeatedly memorialized to resign the chief ministership; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jifu's resignations were refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，張煦入單于都護府，誅作亂軍士蘇國珍等二百五十二人。

translations.literal: On yihai Zhang Xu entered the Shanyu Protectorate headquarters and executed the mutineer Su Guozhen and 252 others.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhang Xu executed 252 Zhenwu mutineers.

sentences.zh: 二月巳卯朔，戶部侍郎、判度支潘孟陽兼京北五城營田使。

translations.literal: Second month, jimao new moon — Vice Minister of Revenue Pan Mengyang overseeing fiscal affairs was also made commissioner of the five northern capital garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mengyang also took northern garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，貶前振武節度使顧進賢為通州刺史，監軍路朝見配役於定陵。

translations.literal: On dingchou former Zhenwu military commissioner Gu Jinxian was demoted to Tong prefect; supervising commissioner Lu Chaojian was assigned labor at Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Gu Jinxian was demoted and Lu Chaojian punished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔以歲饑，放關內元和八年己前逋租錢粟，賑常平義倉粟三十萬石。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict: because of yearly famine, arrears of rent and grain in Guannei before Yuanhe 8 were remitted, and 300,000 shi from Ever-Normal and Charity granaries were distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei famine amnesty and 300,000 shi of relief were ordered.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜振武軍絹二萬匹。

translations.literal: On bingshen Zhenwu was granted twenty thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhenwu received twenty thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，月近心大星。

translations.literal: On dingyou the moon drew near Antares.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the moon neared Antares.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，制朝議大夫、守中書侍郎、同平章事、上柱國、高邑男李絳守禮部尚書，累表辭相位故也。

translations.literal: On guimao a decree made Li Jiang, Court Counsel Grand Master, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Grand Councillor, Pillar of State, Baron of Gaoyi, continue as Minister of Rites — because he had repeatedly memorialized to resign the chief ministership.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Jiang left the council but kept Rites after repeated resignations.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉朔。

translations.literal: Third month, jiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The third month opened on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，巂州地震，晝夜八十震，壓死者百餘人。

translations.literal: On bingchen Xi prefecture earthquake — eighty shocks day and night; more than a hundred were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen a Xi earthquake killed over a hundred.

sentences.zh: 庚申，妖人梁叔高自廣州來，授書與吏部侍郎楊於陵，使為己輔。

translations.literal: On gengshen the sorcerer Liang Shugao came from Guangzhou and gave a book to Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Yuling, asking to be made his aide.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen a Guangzhou sorcerer tried to enlist Yang Yuling.

sentences.zh: 於陵執之以告，殺之。

translations.literal: Yuling seized him and reported; he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuling arrested and executed him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子少傅鄭餘慶檢佼右僕射、興元尹、山南西道節度使，代趙宗儒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On xinyou Crown Prince Junior Tutor Zheng Yuqing was made acting Right Vice Premier, Xingyuan intendant, and Shannan West military commissioner, replacing Zhao Zongru as Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zheng Yuqing took Shannan West and the censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，隕霜殺桑。

translations.literal: On dingmao frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao late frost destroyed mulberries.

sentences.zh: 召大理卿裴棠棣男損、前昭應令杜式方男忭見於麟德殿前，各賜緋，許尚公主。

translations.literal: Summoned to audience before Linde Hall Pei Tangdi's son Sun and former Zhaoying Director Du Shifang's son Bian; each was granted scarlet robes and permitted to marry princesses.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons of high officials were summoned and permitted imperial marriages.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened on wuyin.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔贈太師咸寧王渾瑊宜配享德宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict: posthumous Grand Preceptor Prince Xianning Hun Zhen was to be enshrined in Dezong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Hun Zhen was ordered enshrined with Dezong.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未朔，以嶺南節度使鄭絪為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingwei new moon — Zheng Yin, Lingnan military commissioner, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zheng Yin became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚申，移宥州於經略軍，郭下置延恩縣，隸夏州觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Youzhou was moved to the pacification army; below the fort Yan'en county was established, subordinate to the Xia observation commissioner. That month drought made grain dear; 700,000 shi from the Great Granary were opened at six sale sites to succor the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou was moved; drought grain sales from the Great Granary fed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 是月旱，穀貴，出太倉粟七十萬石，開六場糶以惠饑民。

translations.literal: On gengshen Youzhou was moved to the pacification army; below the fort Yan'en county was established, subordinate to the Xia observation commissioner. That month drought made grain dear; 700,000 shi from the Great Granary were opened at six sale sites to succor the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou was moved; drought grain sales from the Great Granary fed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，桂王綸薨。

translations.literal: On yichou Prince Gui of Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Prince Gui of Gui, son of the emperor, died.

sentences.zh: 以旱，免京畿夏稅十三萬石、青苗錢五萬貫。

translations.literal: Because of drought, 130,000 shi of summer tax in the capital region and 50,000 strings of green-seed money were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Drought brought remission of capital summer tax and seed loans.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on bingzi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以天德軍經略使周懷乂卒，廢朝一日。

translations.literal: On wuyin Tiantede pacification commissioner Zhou Huaiyi died; court was suspended one day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhou Huaiyi died and court mourned one day.

sentences.zh: 經略使廢朝，自懷乂始也。

translations.literal: Suspending court for a pacification commissioner began with Huaiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Court mourning for a frontier commissioner began with Huaiyi.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以義武軍節度副使渾鎬檢校式工尚書，兼定州大都督府長史，充義武軍節度使、易定觀察使、北平軍等使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Hun Gao, Yiwu vice military commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Administrator of Ding prefecture, Yiwu military commissioner, Yi-Ding observation commissioner, and Beiping army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Hun Gao took Yiwu and Ding.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以在龍武將軍燕重旰為豐州刺史、天德軍豐州西城中城都防禦押蕃落等使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Yan Chonggan, Left Dragon Martial general, was made Feng prefect, Tiantede Fengzhou Western Middle City metropolitan defense commissioner overseeing fan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yan Chonggan took Feng and Tiantede defense.

sentences.zh: 乙未，置禮賓院於長興里之北。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Ritual Guests Hostel was established north of Changxing Ward.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin a hostel for tributary guests opened north of Changxing.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以左丞孔戣為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: On renyin Left Assistant Kong Zhe was made Hua prefect, Tong Pass defense commissioner, and Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Kong Zhe took Hua and Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制河中晉絳慈隰等州節度使張弘靖守刑部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On renyin a decree made Zhang Hongjing, Hedong Jin- Jiang- Ci- Long military commissioner, continue as Minister of Justice and concurrent Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhang Hongjing joined the Grand Council while keeping Justice.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以御史大夫趙宗儒檢校尚書右僕射，兼河中尹、河中晉絳等州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Censor-in-Chief Zhao Zongru was made acting Right Vice Premier, concurrent Hedong intendant and Hedong Jin-Jiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhao Zongru took Hedong with vice premier rank.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以太子司議郎杜忭為銀青光祿大夫、殿中少監、駙馬都尉，尚岐陽公主。

translations.literal: On wuchen Du Bian, Crown Prince remonstrance officer, was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Palace Vice Director, Commandant of Escorts, and married Princess Qiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Du Bian married Princess Qiyang with high court rank.

sentences.zh: 閏八月乙巳朔。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, yisi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The intercalary eighth month opened on yisi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以河陽節度使烏重胤兼汝州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou Wu Chongyin, Heyang military commissioner, was also made Ru prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Wu Chongyin added Ru prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以中書舍人王涯、屯田郎中韋綬為皇太子諸王侍讀。

translations.literal: On renxu Secretariat drafting commissioner Wang Ya and Bureau of Revenue director Wei Shou were made readers for the crown prince and princes.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Ya and Wei Shou tutored the heir and princes.

sentences.zh: 己巳，加田弘正檢校右僕射，賞三軍錢二十萬貫。

translations.literal: On jihai Tian Hongzheng was promoted acting Right Vice Premier and granted the three armies 200,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Tian Hongzheng was promoted and his armies rewarded.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌朔，以洺州刺史李光顏為陳州刺史、忠武軍都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiaxu new moon — Li Guangyan, Luo prefect, was made Chen prefect and Zhongwu army director of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Li Guangyan took Chen and Zhongwu command.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以山南東道節度使袁滋檢校兵部尚書，兼江陵尹、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Yuan Zi, Shannan East military commissioner, was made acting Minister of War, concurrent Jiangling intendant and Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yuan Zi took Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 以荊南節度使嚴綬檢校司空、襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Yan Shou, Jingnan military commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works, Xiang prefect, and Shannan East military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shou took Shannan East.

sentences.zh: 己丑，月掩軒轅。

translations.literal: On jichou the moon occulted the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the moon eclipsed the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 淮西節度使吳少陽卒，其子元濟匿喪，自總兵柄乃焚劫舞陽等四縣。

translations.literal: Huaixi military commissioner Wu Shaoyang died; his son Yuanji concealed the mourning, seized military power, then burned and plundered Wuyang and three other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoyang died; his son Yuanji hid the death, took the army, and raided four counties.

sentences.zh: 朝廷遣使吊祭，拒而不納。

translations.literal: The court sent envoys to mourn; they were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial mourners were turned away.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，真臘國朝貢。

translations.literal: On renchen Zhenla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zhenla presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，加河東節度使王鍔檢校司空、同平章事，以給事中孟簡為越州刺史、浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Hedong military commissioner Wang E was promoted acting Minister of Works and concurrent Grand Councillor; supervising secretary Meng Jian was made Yue prefect and Zhedong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wang E joined the council; Meng Jian took Zhedong.

sentences.zh: 贈吳少陽尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Posthumous rank of Minister of Works Right Vice Premier was granted to Wu Shaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoyang was posthumously honored as vice premier.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰朔。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiachen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth month opened on jiachen.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金紫光錄大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事、集賢大學士、監修國史、上柱國、趙國公李吉甫卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu Li Jifu, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, Director of National History, Pillar of State, Duke of Zhao, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Jifu died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以刑部員外郎令狐楚為職方員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: On jiayin Vice Minister of Justice Linghu Chu was made Bureau of Appointments Vice Director and edict drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Linghu Chu entered drafting.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以忠武軍節度使韓皋為吏部尚書，以忠武軍節度副使兼陳州刺史李光顏為許州刺史、忠武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu Han Gao, Zhongwu military commissioner, was made Minister of Personnel; Zhongwu vice commissioner and concurrent Chen prefect Li Guangyan was made Xu prefect and Zhongwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Han Gao took Personnel; Li Guangyan took Zhongwu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，制：「朕嗣膺寶位，於茲十年。

translations.literal: On jiazi a decree: "I have inherited the precious throne these ten years."
translations.idiomatic: An edict on the Huai campaign opened:

sentences.zh: 每推至誠，以御方夏，庶以仁化，臻於太和，宵衣旰食，意屬於此。

translations.literal: Each day I push utmost sincerity to govern the realm, hoping benevolent transformation may reach great harmony — I rise at dawn and dine at dusk with my heart set on this.
translations.idiomatic: "Ten years on the throne I have ruled from dawn to dusk for harmony."

sentences.zh: 今淮西一道，未達朝經。

translations.literal: Now the Huaixi circuit has not attained the court's standard.
translations.idiomatic: "Huaixi has defied the court."

sentences.zh: 擅自繼襲，肆行寇掠。

translations.literal: It has seized succession on its own and wantonly raids and plunders.
translations.idiomatic: "Its heir seized power and raids the borders."

sentences.zh: 將士等迫於受制，非是本心。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers are forced under control — it is not their true heart.
translations.idiomatic: "Soldiers serve under compulsion, not loyalty."

sentences.zh: 思去三面之羅，庶遵兩階之義。

translations.literal: I think to remove the net on three sides and hope to follow the meaning of the two stairways."
translations.idiomatic: "I would lift the net on three sides and offer the two-stairway peace."

sentences.zh: 宜以山南東道節度使嚴綬兼充申光蔡等州招撫使。

translations.literal: Yan Shou, Shannan East military commissioner, is fittingly also made pacification commissioner of Shen-Guang-Cai and other prefectures."
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shou was named pacification commissioner for Shen-Guang-Cai.

sentences.zh: 」仍命內常侍崔潭峻為監軍。

translations.literal: Palace Inner Regular Attendant Cui Tanjun was also made army supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Tanjun was named campaign supervisor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以尚書左丞呂元膺檢校工部尚書、東都留守。

translations.literal: On wuchen Lü Yuanying, Left Assistant Minister of State, was made acting Minister of Works and Eastern Capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Lü Yuanying became Luoyang guardian.

sentences.zh: 舊例，命留守賜旗甲，與方鎮同，及元膺受命，不賜。

translations.literal: Former precedent: appointing a guardian granted banners and armor as with a regional commissioner; when Yuanying received appointment, none were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang guardians once received banners like commissioners; Yuanying received none.

sentences.zh: 諫官援華、汝、壽三州例有賜，居守之重，不宜獨闕，上曰：「此三處亦宜停賜。

translations.literal: Remonstrance officials cited Hua, Ru, and Shou as precedents for grants; the weight of holding the capital should not alone be denied. The Emperor said: "Those three places should also cease receiving grants."
translations.idiomatic: Censors protested; the emperor ended grants for Hua, Ru, and Shou as well.
Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiaxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on jiaxu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以吏部尚書韓皋為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On jiashen Han Gao, Minister of Personnel, was made Crown Prince Guest.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Han Gao became crown prince guest.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以御史中丞胡證為單于大都護、振武麟勝等軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Vice Censor-in-Chief Hu Zheng was made Shanyu Grand Protector and Zhenwu Lin-Sheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Hu Zheng took Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太子太傅範希朝卒。

translations.literal: On dingyou Crown Prince Grand Tutor Fan Xichao died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Fan Xichao died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以中書舍人裴度為御史中丞；

translations.literal: On wuxu Secretariat drafting commissioner Pei Du was made Vice Censor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Pei Du became vice censor-in-chief;

sentences.zh: 以左金吾大將軍郭釗檢校工部尚書、邠州刺史，充邠寧節度使；

translations.literal: Left Golden Guard Grand General Guo Zhao was made acting Minister of Works, Bin prefect, and Binning military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhao took Binning;

sentences.zh: 以職方員外郎、知制誥令狐楚為翰林學士。

translations.literal: Bureau of Appointments Vice Director and edict drafter Linghu Chu was made Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Chu entered the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened on jiachen.

sentences.zh: 丁未，振武節度使張煦卒。

translations.literal: On dingwei Zhenwu military commissioner Zhang Xu died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhang Xu died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，邠寧節度使、檢校右僕射閻巨源卒。

translations.literal: On xinhai Binning military commissioner, acting Right Vice Premier Yan Juyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Yan Juyuan died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，兵部尚書王紹卒。

translations.literal: On guichou Minister of War Wang Shao died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wang Shao died.

sentences.zh: 己未，右羽林統軍孟元陽卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei Right Forest commander Meng Yuanyang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Meng Yuanyang died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太子少保趙昌卒。

translations.literal: On bingyin Crown Prince Junior Guardian Zhao Chang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhao Chang died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，制以中大夫、守尚書右丞、上騎都尉、賜紫金魚袋韋貫之本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On wuchen a decree made Wei Guanzhi, Palace Attendant Grand Master, acting Right Assistant Minister of State, Upper Cavalry Commandant, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally, continue in office as concurrent Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wei Guanzhi joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 元和十年十年春正月癸酉朔。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 10 — In spring of Yuanhe 10, first month, guiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 10 opened on guiyou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，宣武軍節度使韓弘守司徒，平章事並如故。

translations.literal: On yiyou Xuanwu military commissioner Han Hong continued as Grand Tutor; Grand Councillor posts remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Han Hong was confirmed Grand Tutor while keeping the council.

sentences.zh: 丙申，嚴綬帥師次蔡州界。

translations.literal: On bingchen Yan Shou's army halted at the Cai prefecture border.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yan Shou camped at the Cai border.

sentences.zh: 己亥，制削奪吳元濟在身官爵。

translations.literal: On jihai a decree stripped Wu Yuanji of all offices held in life.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wu Yuanji was posthumously stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 庚子，桂管奏移富州治於故城。

translations.literal: On gengzi Gui observation memorialized moving Fu prefecture's seat to the old city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Gui moved Fu prefecture back to its old seat.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯朔。

translations.literal: Second month, guimao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on guimao.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，嚴綬軍為賊所襲，敗於磁丘，退守唐州。

translations.literal: On jiachen Yan Shou's army was ambushed by bandits and defeated at Ciqu; it withdrew to guard Tang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yan Shou was routed at Ciqu and fell back to Tang.

sentences.zh: 田弘正子布、韓弘子公武各率師隸李光顏討賊。

translations.literal: Tian Hongzheng's son Bu and Han Hong's son Gongwu each led troops under Li Guangyan to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of Tian Hongzheng and Han Hong joined Li Guangyan against Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以禮部尚書李絳為華州潼關防禦鎮軍等使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Li Jiang, Minister of Rites, was made Hua prefect, Tong Pass defense commissioner, and Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Jiang took Hua.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，河東防秋將劉輔殺豐州刺史燕重旰。

translations.literal: On renxu Hedong autumn-defense officer Liu Fu killed Feng prefect Yan Chonggan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Liu Fu murdered Yan Chonggan at Feng.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以羽林將軍李匯為涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On jisi Forest general Li Hui was made Jingyuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Hui took Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申朔，以右金吾將軍李奉仙為豐州刺史、天德軍西城中城都防禦使。

translations.literal: Third month, renshen new moon — Right Golden Guard general Li Fengxian was made Feng prefect and Tiantede Western Middle City metropolitan defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Fengxian took Feng.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以劍南西川節度行軍司馬李程為兵部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On jimao Li Cheng, Xichuan campaign staff officer, was made Bureau of War director and edict drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Cheng entered drafting.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以虔州司馬韓泰為漳刑刺史，以永州司馬柳宗元為柳州刺史、饒州司馬韓曄為汀州刺史，朗州司馬劉禹錫為播州刺史，臺州司馬陳諫為封州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou Qianzhou Registrar Han Tai was made Zhang prefect; Yongzhou Registrar Liu Zongyuan was made Liu prefect; Raozhou Registrar Han Ye was made Ting prefect; Langzhou Registrar Liu Yuxi was made Bo prefect; Taizhou Registrar Chen Jian was made Feng prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou five exiled scholars were appointed distant prefects.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞裴度以禹錫母老，請移近處，乃改授連州刺史。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Pei Du, because Liu Yuxi's mother was old, requested a nearer post; he was then reassigned Lian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du moved Liu Yuxi nearer for his aged mother.

sentences.zh: 贈故太常卿崔邠禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Former Grand Director of the Imperial Clan Cui Bin was posthumously made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Bin was posthumously honored as Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 李光顏破賊於南頓。

translations.literal: Li Guangyan defeated the rebels at Nandun.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan won at Nandun.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，盜焚河陰轉運院，凡燒錢帛二十萬貫匹、米二萬四千八百石、倉室五十五間。

translations.literal: On xinhai bandits burned the Heyin transport compound — twenty thousand strings and bolts of cash and silk, 24,800 shi of rice, and fifty-five storehouses were burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai rebels burned the Heyin depot and millions in stores.

sentences.zh: 防院兵五百人營於縣南，盜火發而不救，呂元膺召其將殺之。

translations.literal: Five hundred garrison troops camped south of the county; when the fire broke out they did not rescue; Lü Yuanying summoned their commander and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yuanying executed garrison officers who failed to fight the Heyin fire.

sentences.zh: 自盜火發河陰，人情駭擾。

translations.literal: From the Heyin fire onward, popular feeling was shaken with alarm.
translations.idiomatic: The capital panicked after the Heyin arson.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以長安縣令徐俊為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On renxu Chang'an county magistrate Xu Jun was made Yong-Guan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xu Jun took Yong-Guan.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on xinwei.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，御史中丞裴度兼刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: On xinsi Vice Censor-in-Chief Pei Du was also made Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Pei Du also took Justice.

sentences.zh: 時度自淮西行營宣慰還，所言軍機，多合上旨，故以兼官寵之。

translations.literal: At the time Du had returned from comforting the Huaixi camp; what he said of military affairs largely matched the Emperor's intent, so he was favored with the concurrent post.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du's Huaixi counsel earned him the concurrent Justice post.

sentences.zh: 丙申，李光顏大破賊黨於洄曲。

translations.literal: On bingchen Li Guangyan inflicted a great defeat on the rebel band at Huiqu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Guangyan crushed the rebels at Huiqu.

sentences.zh: 自徵兵討賊，凡十餘鎮之師，環於申、蔡，未立戰功。

translations.literal: Since troops were raised to attack the rebels, more than ten circuits' armies ringed Shen and Cai yet had not achieved battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: A dozen circuits had besieged Shen and Cai without victory.

sentences.zh: 裴度使還，奏曰：「臣觀諸將，惟光顏見義能勇，必能立功。

translations.literal: When Pei Du returned from his mission he memorialized: "Among the generals I observe, only Guangyan sees righteousness and can be brave — he will certainly achieve merit."
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du had predicted only Li Guangyan would win.

sentences.zh: 」至是告捷，京師相賀，上尤賞度之知人。

translations.literal: When victory was announced, the capital congratulated one another; the Emperor especially prized Du's knowledge of men.
translations.idiomatic: Victory at Huiqu vindicated Pei Du before the court.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinchou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on xinchou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，鎮州節度使王承宗盜夜伏於靖安坊，刺宰相武元衡，死之；

translations.literal: On guimao Wang Chengzong, Zhen military commissioner, sent assassins by night to lurk in Jing'an Ward and stab Grand Councillor Wu Yuanheng to death;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wang Chengzong's men murdered Wu Yuanheng in Jing'an Ward;

sentences.zh: 又遣盜於通化坊刺御史中丞裴度，傷首而免。

translations.literal: he also sent assassins in Tonghua Ward to stab Vice Censor-in-Chief Pei Du — Du was wounded in the head but escaped.
translations.idiomatic: the same night Pei Du was wounded in Tonghua but survived.

sentences.zh: 是日，京城大駭，自京師至諸門加衛兵；

translations.literal: That day the capital was greatly alarmed; from the capital to every gate guards were increased;
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an locked down with guards at every gate;

sentences.zh: 宰相導從加金吾騎士，出入則彀弦露刃，每過里門，訶索甚諠；

translations.literal: chief ministers' escorts added Golden Guard horsemen; going out or in they strung bows and bared blades; passing each ward gate the shouting and searching was very clamorous;
translations.idiomatic: ministers rode under armed escort with searches at every ward;

sentences.zh: 公卿持事柄者，以家僮兵仗自隨。

translations.literal: high officials holding power all followed with household slaves and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: powerful officials armed their household retinues.

sentences.zh: 武元衡死數日，未獲賊。

translations.literal: Several days after Wu Yuanheng's death the assassins were still not captured.
translations.idiomatic: Days passed without arresting the killers.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎許孟容請見，奏曰：「豈有國相橫尸路隅，不能擒賊！

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Xu Mengrong requested audience and memorialized: "How can a state minister lie slaughtered at a roadside and the assassins not be seized!"
translations.idiomatic: Xu Mengrong wept before the throne that the killers still roamed free.

sentences.zh: 」因灑泣極言，上為之憤嘆。

translations.literal: He wept and spoke to the limit; the Emperor sighed in anger for him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor raged at his tears.

sentences.zh: 乃詔京城諸道，能捕賊者賞錢萬貫，仍與五品官，敢有蓋藏，全家誅戮。

translations.literal: Then an edict: throughout the capital circuits, whoever could capture the assassins would receive ten thousand strings and a fifth-rank office; whoever dared conceal them — whole household executed.
translations.idiomatic: A ten-thousand-string bounty and fifth rank were offered; concealment meant family execution.

sentences.zh: 乃積錢二萬貫於東西市。

translations.literal: Then 20,000 strings were piled at the eastern and western markets.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand strings were displayed in the markets.

sentences.zh: 京城大索，公卿節將復壁重轑者皆搜之。

translations.literal: A great search swept the capital; even grandees and military commissioners who walled and layered their carriages were searched.
translations.idiomatic: Even walled mansions of generals were searched.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，神策將士王士則、王士平以盜名上言，且言王承宗所使，乃捕得張晏等八人誅之。

translations.literal: On gengxu Divine Strategy officers Wang Shize and Wang Shiping reported the assassins by name and said Wang Chengzong had sent them; Zhang Yan and eight others were then seized and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang Shize named Zhang Yan's gang as Chengzong's agents; eight were executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，制以朝議郎、守御史中丞、兼刑部侍郎、飛騎尉、賜紫金魚袋裴度為朝請大夫、守刑部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On yichou a decree made Pei Du, Court Counsel Grand Master, acting Vice Censor-in-Chief, concurrent Vice Minister of Justice, Flying Cavalry Commandant, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally, Court Cadet Grand Master, acting Vice Minister of Justice, and concurrent Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou wounded Pei Du was elevated to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午朔，靈武節度使李光進卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu new moon — Lingwu military commissioner Li Guangjin died.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened with Li Guangjin's death.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以神策軍長武城使杜叔良為朔方、靈鹽、定遠城節度觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinwei Du Shuliang, Changwu town commissioner of the Divine Strategy, was made Shuofang Ling-Salt Dingyuan military observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Du Shuliang took Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「成德軍節度使王承宗，自滌瑕疵，累加獎拔，列在維籓之任，待以忠正之徒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict: "Chengde military commissioner Wang Chengzong, since washing away flaws, has been repeatedly rewarded and promoted, placed in the duty of the frontier screen, treated as a loyal and upright man."
translations.idiomatic: An edict against Wang Chengzong began:

sentences.zh: 謂懷君父之恩，克勵人臣之節。

translations.literal: We said he would cherish the grace of ruler and father and strive to fulfill a minister's integrity.
translations.idiomatic: "We treated him as a loyal vassal."

sentences.zh: 而動思棄命，恣逞非心，傲狠反常，橫辱無畏。

translations.literal: Yet he constantly thought to abandon his charge and indulged an unrighteous heart — arrogant, fierce, contrary to norm, insulting and lawless without fear.
translations.idiomatic: "Instead he turned arrogant and lawless."

sentences.zh: 以其先祖，嘗立忠動，每念含容，庶聞悛革。

translations.literal: Because his forebears once stood in loyal merit, each time we thought to contain and pardon, hoping to hear repentance and reform.
translations.idiomatic: "His ancestors' merit bought him repeated pardon."

sentences.zh: 曾不知陰謀逆狀，久則逾彰；

translations.literal: He never knew that secret plots and rebellious conduct, long continued, grow ever clearer;
translations.idiomatic: "His plots only grew clearer."

sentences.zh: 兇德禍機，盈而自覆。

translations.literal: vicious conduct and the engine of disaster, full, overturns itself.
translations.idiomatic: "His wickedness finally overflowed."

sentences.zh: 乃敢輕肆指斥，妄陳表章，潛遣奸人，內懷兵刃，賊殺元輔，毒傷憲臣，縱其兇殘，無所顧望。

translations.literal: He dared lightly and wildly to point and revile, rashly submitting memorials, secretly sending traitors, inwardly bearing blades, murdering the chief minister and poisoning and wounding the censor-in-chief, indulging his fierce cruelty without regard.
translations.idiomatic: "He murdered Wu Yuanheng and wounded Pei Du without restraint."

sentences.zh: 推窮事跡，罪狀昭明，周覽讞詞，良用驚嘆。

translations.literal: Pursuing the matter to the end, his crimes are clear; reading the full indictment, we are truly appalled.
translations.idiomatic: "His guilt is now plain and appalling."

sentences.zh: 宜令絕其朝貢，其所部博野、樂壽兩縣本屬范陽，宜卻隸劉總。

translations.literal: His court tribute is to be cut off; his circuits' Boye and Leshou two counties, originally belonging to Fanyang, are to be returned to Liu Zong's jurisdiction."
translations.idiomatic: Tribute was cut and two counties returned to Liu Zong.

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉王承系、太子贊善王承迪、丹王府司馬王承榮等，並宜遠郡安置。

translations.literal: Commandant of Escorts Wang Chengsi, Crown Prince Companion Wang Chengdi, Danwang Mansion staff officer Wang Chengrong, and others are all to be settled in distant prefectures."
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong's kin were exiled to distant posts. Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」先是，承宗上表怨咎武元衡，留中不報。

translations.literal: Earlier Chengzong had submitted a memorial blaming Wu Yuanheng; it was kept within and not answered.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong's earlier blame of Wu Yuanheng had been suppressed.

sentences.zh: 又肆指斥，上使持其表以示百官，群臣皆請問罪。

translations.literal: He again wildly pointed and reviled; the Emperor had his memorial shown to the hundred officials — all the ministers requested punishment.
translations.idiomatic: His new insults were shown to ministers, who demanded punishment.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，涇原節度使李匯卒，以將作監王潛為涇州刺史、四鎮北庭涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Jingyuan military commissioner Li Hui died; Master of Works Wang Qian was made Jing prefect and Four Garrisons Northern March Jingyuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Hui died; Wang Qian took Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以京兆尹裴武為司農卿，以捕賊弛慢故也。

translations.literal: On yiwei Pei Wu, Jingzhao intendant, was made Minister of Agriculture — for slackness in capturing assassins.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Pei Wu was demoted to Agriculture for failing to catch assassins.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jihai new moon — the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened with a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，訶陵國遣使獻僧祗僮及五色鸚鵡、頻伽鳥並異香名寶。

translations.literal: On bingyin Kaling sent envoys presenting monk robes, five-colored parrots, bhramara birds, and exotic incense and precious objects.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Kaling sent exotic birds and treasures.
