sentences.zh: 丁未，淄青節度使李師道陰與嵩山僧圓凈謀反，勇士數百人伏於東都進奏院，乘洛城無兵，欲竊發焚燒宮殿而肆行剽掠。

translations.literal: On dingwei Ziqing military commissioner Li Shidao secretly plotted with Songshan monk Yuanjing to rebel; several hundred braves lay in ambush at Luoyang's eastern memorial court — when the eastern capital lacked troops they meant to seize the moment, burn the palaces, and plunder wildly.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shidao plotted with monk Yuanjing to burn Luoyang when troops were away.

sentences.zh: 小將場進、李再興告變，留守呂元膺乃出兵圍之，賊突圍而出，入嵩岳，山棚盡擒之。

translations.literal: Junior officers Chang Jin and Li Zaixing reported the plot; guardian Lü Yuanying then sent troops to surround them; the rebels broke out and fled into Songshan; mountain huts captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yuanying crushed the plot after Chang Jin and Li Zaixing informed.

sentences.zh: 訊其首，僧圓凈主謀也。

translations.literal: On interrogation the ringleader was monk Yuanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjing was named the mastermind.

sentences.zh: 僧臨刑嘆曰：「誤我事，不得使洛城流血！

translations.literal: At execution the monk sighed: "You have ruined my affair — you could not let Luoyang bleed!
translations.idiomatic: At the block Yuanjing cried that his plot had failed to make Luoyang bleed.
Thus ended his words.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，以宣武軍節度使韓弘充淮西行營兵馬都統。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guiyou — Xuanwu military commissioner Han Hong was made overall commander of the Huaixi campaign armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Han Hong commanded the Huaixi front.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以太子賓客韓皋為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingyou Crown Prince Guest Han Gao was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Han Gao became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，始析山南東道為兩節度，以戶部侍郎李遜為襄州刺史，充襄、復、郢、均、房節度使；

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengzi — Shannan East was first divided into two circuits; Vice Minister of Revenue Li Xun was made Xiang prefect and Xiang-Fu-Ying-Jun-Fang military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Shannan East split; Li Xun took the western half.

sentences.zh: 以右羽林將軍高霞寓為唐州刺史，充唐、隨、鄧節度使。

translations.literal: Right Forest general Gao Xiayu was made Tang prefect and Tang-Sui-Deng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xiayu took Tang-Sui-Deng.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書權德輿奏請行用新刪定《敕格》三十卷，從之。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Quan Deyu memorialized requesting use of the newly revised thirty-scroll Statutes and Ordinances; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Deyu's revised Statutes in thirty scrolls were adopted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以太子賓客于頔為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On renzi Crown Prince Guest Yu Di was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yu Di returned as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，詔出內庫繒絹五十五萬匹供軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuchen — an edict released 550,000 bolts of palace silk and damask for the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month 550,000 bolts were issued to the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以山南東道節度使嚴綬為太子少保。

translations.literal: On yihai Yan Shou, Shannan East military commissioner, was made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Yan Shou became crown prince tutor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，盜焚獻陵寢宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin bandits burned Xianling's mausoleum hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin rebels burned Xianling.

sentences.zh: 詔發振武兵二千，會義武軍以討王承宗。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched two thousand Zhenwu troops to join Yiwu in attacking Wang Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenwu and Yiwu were ordered against Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅夜，太白犯鎮星。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renyin night — Venus transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On a winter night Venus crossed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李願擊敗李師道之眾九千，斬首二千級。

translations.literal: On jiachen Li Yuan defeated nine thousand of Li Shidao's troops and beheaded two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Yuan slew two thousand of Li Shidao's men.

sentences.zh: 壬子，東都留守呂元膺請募置三河子弟以衛宮城。

translations.literal: On renzi Eastern Capital guardian Lü Yuanying requested permission to recruit Sanhe youths to guard the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Lü Yuanying sought local Sanhe youths to guard Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，越州復置山陰縣。

translations.literal: On jiayin Yuezhou restored Shanyin county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Shanyin county was restored.

sentences.zh: 庚申，新造指南車、記里鼓。

translations.literal: On gengshen new south-pointing chariots and mile-drums were made.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen new south-pointing chariots and mile-drums were built.

sentences.zh: 出宮人七十二人置京城寺觀，有家者歸之。

translations.literal: Seventy-two palace women were placed in capital temples and monasteries; those with families were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-two palace women were released to temples or kin.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，河東節度使王鍔卒。

translations.literal: On yichou Hedong military commissioner Wang E died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang E died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，渤海、新羅、奚、契丹、黑水、南詔、牂柯並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Bo Hai, Silla, Xi, Khitan, Mohe, Nanzhao, and Zangke all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Seven frontier states sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 元和十一年十一年春正月丁卯朔，以宿師於野，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 11 — In spring of Yuanhe 11, first month, dingmao new moon; because troops were long encamped in the field, court congratulations were not received.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 11 opened without New Year audience because armies were in the field.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以中書侍郎、平章事張弘靖檢校吏部尚書，兼太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On jisi Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor Zhang Hongjing was made acting Minister of Personnel, concurrent Taiyuan intendant, Northern Capital guardian, and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhang Hongjing took Taiyuan and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔群臣曰：「今用兵已久，利害相半。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict to the ministers said: "War has now lasted long; advantage and harm are half and half."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the emperor asked ministers to debate the war.

sentences.zh: 其攻守之宜，罰宥之要，宜各具議狀以聞。

translations.literal: The fit of attack and defense, the essentials of punishment and pardon — each should submit a considered memorial."
translations.idiomatic: "Submit plans for attack, defense, and amnesty."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，翰林學士錢徽、蕭俯各守本官，以上疏請罷兵故也。

translations.literal: On gengchen Hanlin academicians Qian Hui and Xiao Fu each kept his original office — for memorializing to stop the war.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Qian Hui and Xiao Fu kept their posts after urging peace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，削奪王承宗在身官爵，所襲封邑賜武俊子金吾將軍士平。

translations.literal: On guiwei Wang Chengzong's living offices were stripped; his inherited fief was granted to Wu Jun's son, Golden Guard general Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Chengzong was stripped and his fief given to Wu Jun's son.

sentences.zh: 令河東、河北道諸鎮加兵進討。

translations.literal: Hedong and Hebei circuits' garrisons were ordered to add troops and advance in attack.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong and Hebei were ordered to reinforce the offensive.

sentences.zh: 甲申，盜斷建陵門戟四十七竿。

translations.literal: On jiashen bandits cut down forty-seven halberds at Jianling's gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen forty-seven halberds were stolen from Jianling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，李光顏奏破賊。

translations.literal: On jiazi Li Guangyan memorialized defeating the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Li Guangyan reported victory.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，吐蕃贊普卒。

translations.literal: Second month, guimao — the Tibetan king died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Tibetan king died.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人、權知禮部貢舉、賜緋魚袋李逢吉為門下侍郎、同平章事，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: Li Fengji, Secretariat drafting commissioner with acting charge of Rites examinations and scarlet fish tally, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor and granted the gold-purple fish tally.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fengji joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 以內庫絹四萬匹賞幽、魏將士。

translations.literal: Forty thousand bolts from the inner treasury were granted to You and Wei troops.
translations.idiomatic: Forty thousand bolts rewarded the Hebei armies.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以華州刺史李絳為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiayin Li Jiang, Hua prefect, was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Jiang became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，月掩心。

translations.literal: On bingchen the moon occulted the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the moon eclipsed the Heart.

sentences.zh: 戊午，南詔蠻酋龍蒙盛卒。

translations.literal: On wuwu Nanzhao chieftain Long Mengsheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Nanzhao ruler died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，皇太后崩於興慶宮之咸寧殿。

translations.literal: Third month, gengwu — the Empress Dowager died in the Xianning Hall of Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the empress dowager died at Xingqing.

sentences.zh: 是日，群臣發喪於西宮兩儀殿，以宰臣裴度為禮儀使，吏部尚書韓皋為大明宮留守，設次於中書。

translations.literal: That day the ministers began mourning at the Two Principles Hall of the Western Palace; chief minister Pei Du was made ritual commissioner; Minister of War Han Gao was made Daming Palace guardian; a mourning lodge was set at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Court mourning began with Pei Du directing rites and Han Gao guarding Daming.

sentences.zh: 辛未，敕諸司公事，宜權取中書門下處分。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict: public business of all offices should provisionally follow Secretariat and Chancellery disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei routine business was routed through the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，分命朝臣告哀於天下。

translations.literal: On guiyou courtiers were dispatched to announce mourning throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou mourning envoys were sent empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，見群臣於紫宸門外廡下。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Emperor received the ministers outside the Zichen Gate colonnade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the emperor met ministers outside Zichen.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以宰臣李逢吉充大行皇太后山陵使。

translations.literal: On jimao chief minister Li Fengji was made commissioner for the Grand Empress Dowager's mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Fengji directed the dowager's burial.

sentences.zh: 出內庫繒帛五萬匹充奉山陵。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand bolts of palace silk and damask were released for the mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand bolts were allotted to the burial.

sentences.zh: 己丑，月近鎮星。

translations.literal: On jichou the moon drew near Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the moon neared Saturn.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，西川節度使李夷簡遣使告哀於南詔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renyin — Xichuan military commissioner Li Yijian sent envoys to announce mourning to Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Yijian notified Nanzhao of the mourning.

sentences.zh: 後喪，邊鎮告四夷，舊制也。

translations.literal: After the mourning, border commands announced to the four barbarians — old statute.
translations.idiomatic: Border posts notifying foreign states after mourning was old law.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，貶戶部侍郎、判度支楊於陵為郴州刺史，坐供軍有闕也。

translations.literal: On gengxu Vice Minister of Revenue overseeing fiscal affairs Yang Yuling was demoted to Chen prefect — for shortfall in army supply.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yang Yuling was demoted for supply failures.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以徐、宿饑，賑粟八萬石。

translations.literal: On dingsi because Xu and Su suffered famine, 80,000 shi of grain were distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xu and Su received 80,000 shi of famine relief.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯夜，辰、歲二宿合於東井。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingmao night — the lodges Chen and Sui conjoined at the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a fifth-month night Chen and Sui met at the Well.

sentences.zh: 宥州軍亂，逐刺史駱怡。

translations.literal: Youzhou army mutinied and drove out prefect Luo Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou mutinied and expelled Luo Yi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李光顏破賊於凌雲柵。

translations.literal: On renshen Li Guangyan defeated the rebels at Lingyun Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Guangyan took Lingyun Stockade.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，高霞寓敗於鐵城，退保新興柵，是日人情悚駭，宰相奏對，多請罷兵。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiachen — Gao Xiayu was defeated at Iron City and withdrew to guard Xinxing Stockade; that day popular feeling was shaken with fear; at imperial audience the chief ministers largely requested stopping the war.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Gao Xiayu's defeat at Iron City revived calls to end the war.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「勝負兵家常勢，不可以一將失利，便沮成計。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Victory and defeat are the constant situation of soldiers — one general's loss must not frustrate the settled plan."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused to abandon the campaign after one defeat.

sentences.zh: 今但議用兵方略，朝廷庶務，制置可否耳。

translations.literal: Now discuss only military strategy; court routine affairs — decide what may or may not be done."
translations.idiomatic: "Debate strategy only, not retreat."

sentences.zh: 」是夜，月掩心後星。

translations.literal: That night the moon occulted the star behind the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon eclipsed a Heart companion star.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，田弘正軍討王承宗，次於南宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu Tian Hongzheng's army attacked Wang Chengzong and halted at Nangong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Tian Hongzheng camped at Nangong against Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，群臣上大行皇太后謚曰莊憲。

translations.literal: On xinyou the ministers submitted the Grand Empress Dowager's posthumous title Zhuangxian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the dowager received the posthumous name Zhuangxian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，貶隨、唐節度使高寓為歸州刺史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingchou — Sui-Tang military commissioner Gao Xiayu was demoted to Gui prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Gao Xiayu was demoted after Iron City.

sentences.zh: 以河南尹鄭權為襄州刺史，充山南東道節度使；

translations.literal: Henan intendant Zheng Quan was made Xiang prefect and Shannan East military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Quan took Shannan East;

sentences.zh: 以荊南節度使袁滋為唐州刺史、彰義軍節度使、申光唐蔡隨鄧州觀察使，權以唐州理為所；

translations.literal: Jingnan military commissioner Yuan Zi was made Tang prefect, Zhangyi army military commissioner, and Shen-Guang-Tang-Cai-Sui-Deng observation commissioner, with authority to govern from Tang;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi took Tang and the Zhangyi front;

sentences.zh: 以華州刺史裴武為江陵尹，充荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Hua prefect Pei Wu was made Jiangling intendant and Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Wu took Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以隨州刺史楊旻為唐州刺史，充行營都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Sui prefect Yang Min was made Tang prefect and acting campaign director of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Min was named Tang commander.

sentences.zh: 以滋儒者，故復以旻將其兵。

translations.literal: Because Zi was a scholar, Min was again made to lead the troops.
translations.idiomatic: A soldier was paired with the scholar Yuan Zi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，宣武軍奏破賊。

translations.literal: On renwu Xuanwu army memorialized defeating the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Xuanwu reported victory.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，以宰臣韋貫之為吏部侍郎，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renyin — chief minister Wei Guanzhi was made Vice Minister of Personnel and ceased concurrent governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wei Guanzhi left the council for Personnel.

sentences.zh: 貫之以淮西、河北兩處用兵，勞於供餉，請緩承宗而專討元濟，與裴度爭論上前故也。

translations.literal: Guanzhi, with war in Huai and Hebei, was wearied supplying the armies and requested easing Chengzong while concentrating on Yuanji — he disputed before the throne with Pei Du for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: He had argued to spare Chengzong and focus on Yuanji, clashing with Pei Du.

sentences.zh: 戊申，容州奏颶風海水毀州城。

translations.literal: On wushen Rong prefecture memorialized that a typhoon and seawater destroyed the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen a typhoon wrecked Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祔莊憲皇后於豐陵。

translations.literal: On jiashen Empress Zhuangxian was enshrined at Fengling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhuangxian was enshrined at Fengling.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，饒州奏浮梁、樂平二縣，五月內暴雨水溢，失四千七百戶，溺死者一百七十人。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingmao — Raozhou memorialized that in the fifth month at Fuliang and Leping two counties violent rain and flooding destroyed 4,700 households; 170 drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Raozhou reported floods that drowned 170.

sentences.zh: 丙子，新除吏部侍郎韋貫之再貶湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingzi newly appointed Vice Minister of Personnel Wei Guanzhi was again demoted to Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wei Guanzhi was sent to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，貶吏部侍郎韋顗為陜州刺史，刑部郎中李正為金州刺史，度支郎中薛公幹為房州刺史，屯田郎中李宣為忠州刺史，考功郎中韋處厚為開州刺史，禮部員外郎崔韶為果州刺史，並為補闕張宿所構，言與貫之朋黨故也。

translations.literal: On xinwei Vice Minister of Personnel Wei Yi was demoted to Shan prefect; Bureau of Justice director Li Zheng to Jin prefect; Fiscal Affairs director Xue Gonggan to Fang prefect; Bureau of Revenue director Li Xuan to Zhong prefect; Bureau of Merit director Wei Chuhou to Kai prefect; Bureau of Rites Vice Director Cui Shao to Guo prefect — all framed by Remonstrance Officer Zhang Su, who said they were Guanzhi's faction.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhang Su exiled a bloc of Wei Guanzhi's allies to remote prefects.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蔡州軍前奏拔凌雲柵。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Cai front memorialized capturing Lingyun Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Cai front reported Lingyun Stockade taken.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，以刑部尚書權德輿檢校吏部尚書，兼興元尹，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingsi — Minister of Justice Quan Deyu was made acting Minister of Personnel, concurrent Xingyuan intendant, and Shannan West military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Quan Deyu took Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幽州劉總加平章事，鄆州李師道加檢校司空。

translations.literal: On bingyin Youzhou Liu Zong was promoted Grand Councillor; Yingzhou Li Shidao was promoted acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Liu Zong joined the council and Li Shidao was promoted.

sentences.zh: 師道聞拔凌雲柵，乃懼，偽貢款誠，故有是令。

translations.literal: When Shidao heard Lingyun Stockade had fallen he grew afraid and falsely offered sincere submission — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shidao feigned loyalty after Lingyun fell.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以司農卿王遂為宣州刺史、宣歙池觀察使，以京兆尹要翛為潤州刺史、浙西觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengwu Minister of Agriculture Wang Sui was made Xuan prefect and Xuan-She-Chi observation commissioner; Jingzhao intendant Yao Song was made Run prefect and Zhexi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wang Sui and Yao Song, fiscal specialists, took rich circuits.

sentences.zh: 以遂、翛常歷計司，能聚斂，方藉供軍，故有斯授。

translations.literal: Because Sui and Song had long served in accounting offices and could gather wealth, and the court relied on them for army supply, these appointments were made.
translations.idiomatic: They were chosen to fund the war through revenue posts.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敕諸道奏事官，非急切不得乘驛馬。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict: memorializing officials of all circuits, unless urgent, may not use relay horses.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen non-urgent memorials were barred from express relay.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，出內庫錢五十萬貫供軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou 500,000 strings were released from the inner treasury for the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou half a million strings went to the armies.

sentences.zh: 戊寅夜，月犯歲。

translations.literal: On wuyin night the moon transgressed Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuyin night the moon crossed Sui.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命內常侍梁守監淮西行營諸軍。

translations.literal: On xinsi Palace Inner Regular Attendant Liang Shou was made supervisor of the Huaixi campaign armies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Liang Shou supervised the Huaixi armies.

sentences.zh: 仍以空名告身五百通及金帛付之。

translations.literal: Blank commission patents for five hundred posts and gold and silk were still given him.
translations.idiomatic: He was given five hundred blank commissions and treasure besides.

sentences.zh: 戊子夜，土、火合於虛、危。

translations.literal: On wuzi night, Earth and Fire conjoined at Void and Rooftop mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Earth and Mars met at Xu and Wei on wuzi night.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，以易州刺史陳楚為定州刺史、義武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingwu — Chen Chu of Yi prefecture was made Dingzhou prefect and Yiwu army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Chu took the Yiwu command on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以翰林學士、尚書工部侍郎、知制誥王涯為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: dingwei — Hanlin academician, Works vice minister, and edict drafter Wang Ya was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ya entered the council on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以閑廄宮苑使李愬檢校左散騎常侍，兼鄧州刺史，充唐、隨、鄧等州節度使。

translations.literal: jiayin — Li Su, commissioner of imperial stud parks and gardens, was made acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant, concurrent Dengzhou prefect, and commissioner of Tang, Sui, Deng and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su received the Tang-Sui-Deng commission on jiayin.

sentences.zh: 初置潁水運使。

translations.literal: The Ying River transport commissioner was first established.
translations.idiomatic: A Ying River grain transport office was created.

sentences.zh: 運揚子院米，自淮陰溯流至壽州，四十里入潁口，又溯流至潁州沈丘界，五百里至於項城，又溯流五百里入溵河，又三百里輸於郾城。

translations.literal: Yangzi Courtyard grain was shipped upriver from Huaiyin to Shouzhou, forty li into the Ying mouth, then upriver five hundred li to the Shenqiu border of Yingzhou, five hundred li to Xiangcheng, then five hundred li into the Yin River, and three hundred li to Yan City.
translations.idiomatic: Grain ran from Huaiyin up the Huai and Ying to Yan City in staged hauls.

sentences.zh: 得米五十萬石，茭一千五百萬束。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain and fifteen million bundles of fodder were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The route delivered fifty thousand shi and vast fodder stores.

sentences.zh: 省汴運七萬六千貫。

translations.literal: Seventy-six thousand strings were saved on Bian transport.
translations.idiomatic: Bian transport costs fell by seventy-six thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 己未，邕管奏黃洞賊屠巖州。

translations.literal: jiwei — Yongguan Circuit reported Yellow Cave bandits massacred Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yongguan reported a massacre at Yan on jiwei.

sentences.zh: 未央宮及飛龍草場火。

translations.literal: Weiyang Palace and the Feilong hay pasture burned.
translations.idiomatic: Fire destroyed Weiyang Palace and the Feilong pasture.

sentences.zh: 京畿水害田，潤、常、湖、衢、陳、許大水。

translations.literal: Capital-region floods harmed fields; Run, Chang, Hu, Qu, Chen, and Xu suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Floods ravaged the capital region and lower Yangtze circuits.

sentences.zh: 是歲冬雷，桃、杏花。

translations.literal: That year there was winter thunder; peach and apricot trees blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: Winter thunder and spring blossoms out of season marked the year.

sentences.zh: 回鶻、奚、契丹、牂柯、渤海等朝貢。

translations.literal: Uighurs, Xi, Khitan, Zangke, Parhae, and others paid court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Border peoples sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 元和十二年十二年春正月辛酉朔，以用兵不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 12 — spring, first month, xinyou new moon: because troops were in the field, the court did not receive New Year congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 12 opened without New Year audience because of the Huai campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸未，貶義武軍節度使渾鎬為循州刺史，坐討賊失律也。

translations.literal: guiwei — Hun Gao of the Yiwu army was demoted to Xunzhou prefect for failing discipline in attacking rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Gao was demoted for botching the rebel campaign on guiwei.

sentences.zh: 甲申，貶唐、鄧節度袁滋為撫州刺史，以上疏請罷兵故也。

translations.literal: jiashen — Yuan Zi of the Tang-Deng commission was demoted to Fuzhou prefect for memorializing to halt the army.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi was exiled for urging an end to the war on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 乙酉夜，星見而雨。

translations.literal: yiyou night — stars appeared while it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Stars shone through rain on yiyou night.

sentences.zh: 戊子夜，彗出畢南，長丈餘，指西南，凡三日，南近參旗而沒。

translations.literal: wuzi night — a comet appeared south of Bi, over a zhang long, pointing southwest; after three days it drew near Can Banner and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: A comet blazed south of Bi for three nights on wuzi.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，以內庫絹布六十九萬段匹、銀五千兩，付度支供軍。

translations.literal: Second month, renshen — sixty-nine myriads of sections of inner-treasury silk and five thousand taels of silver were delivered to Revenue to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: Inner stores funded the campaign on renshen.

sentences.zh: 庚子，敕京城居人五家相保，以搜奸慝。

translations.literal: gengzi — an edict ordered capital households to guarantee one another in groups of five to search out traitors.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing residents were grouped for traitor hunts on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 時王承宗、李師道欲阻用兵之勢，遣人折陵廟之戟，焚芻槁之積，流矢飛書，恐駭京國，故搜索以防奸。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Chengzong and Li Shidao wished to obstruct the military effort; they sent men to break mausoleum halberds, burn fodder stacks, and shoot arrows and letters to terrify the capital — hence the search against traitors.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei agents tried to panic Chang'an, prompting household searches.

sentences.zh: 及賊平，復得淄青簿領，中有賞蒲、潼關吏案，乃知容奸者關吏也，搜索不足以為防。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, recovered Ziqing registers contained cases rewarding Pu and Tong Pass clerks — thus knowing the gate clerks had harbored traitors; search alone was no defense.
translations.idiomatic: Captured ledgers showed Tong Pass clerks had aided rebels, not street searches.

sentences.zh: 庚申，敕宜於許汝行營側近置行郾城，以處賊中歸降人戶。

translations.literal: gengshen — an edict ordered establishing a field Yan City near the Xu-Ru campaign camp to settle surrendered rebel households.
translations.idiomatic: A camp Yan City was set up for surrenders on gengshen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，岳鄂團練使李道古師攻申州，克羅城，賊力戰，道古之眾大敗。

translations.literal: jiayin — Yue-E training commissioner Li Daogu led troops against Shenzhou, took the outer wall, but the rebels fought hard and Daogu's force was routed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Daogu stormed Shenzhou's outer wall and was thrown back on jiayin.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，昭義郗士美兵敗於柏鄉，兵士死者千人。

translations.literal: Third month, renxu — Zhaoyi's Heshimei was defeated at Baixiang; a thousand soldiers died.
translations.idiomatic: Heshimei lost a thousand men at Baixiang on renxu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，滄州程執恭改名權。

translations.literal: wuchen — Cheng Zhigong of Cangzhou changed his name to Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhigong of Cangzhou was renamed Quan on wuchen.

sentences.zh: 太常定李吉甫謚曰「敬憲」，度支郎中張仲方非之，上怒，貶為遂州司馬。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices fixed Li Jifu's posthumous name as "Respectful and August"; Revenue bureau director Zhang Zhongfang objected; the Emperor was angry and demoted him to Suizhou adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhongfang was banished for disputing Li Jifu's posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 賜吉甫謚曰忠。

translations.literal: Jifu was granted the posthumous name Loyal.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jifu's posthumous name was fixed as Loyal.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，月犯心後星。

translations.literal: dingchou — the moon trespassed the rear Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: The moon crossed the rear Heart star on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賊將吳秀琳以文城柵兵三千降李愬。

translations.literal: guiwei — rebel Wu Xiulin surrendered Wencheng stockade with three thousand troops to Li Su.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xiulin surrendered Wencheng to Li Su on guiwei.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，李光顏破賊三萬於郾城，殺其卒什二三，獲馬千匹、器甲三萬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao — Li Guangyan broke thirty thousand rebels at Yan City, killing two or three in ten, capturing a thousand horses and thirty thousand suits of armor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan shattered a rebel host at Yan City on xinmao.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，駙馬都尉於季友居嫡母喪，與進士劉師服歡宴夜飲。

translations.literal: xinchou — Son-in-law Director Yu Jiyou, while in chief mother's mourning, feasted and drank at night with jinshi Liu Shifu.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jiyou caroused through mourning with Liu Shifu on xinchou.

sentences.zh: 季友削官爵，苔四十，忠州安置；

translations.literal: Jiyou was stripped of rank and title, given forty blows, and settled at Zhongzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Jiyou lost his titles, was flogged, and sent to Zhongzhou;

sentences.zh: 師服笞四十，配流連州；

translations.literal: Shifu was given forty blows and exiled to Lianzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Shifu was flogged and exiled to Lianzhou;

sentences.zh: 于頔不能訓子，削階。

translations.literal: Yu Di was unable to discipline his son — his rank was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Di was demoted for failing to control his son.

sentences.zh: 己酉，出太倉粟二十五萬石糶於西京，以惠饑民。

translations.literal: jiyou — twenty-five myriad shi from the Great Granary were sold in the western capital to succor the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: Charity grain from the Great Granary was sold in the west on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，敕改蔡州吳房縣為遂平縣，移置於文城柵南新城內。

translations.literal: gengxu — an edict changed Cai prefecture's Wu Fang county to Suiping county and moved it within the new city south of Wencheng stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Fang was renamed Suiping and relocated on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賊郾城守將鄧懷金與縣令董昌以郾城降。

translations.literal: dingmao — rebel Yan City defender Deng Huaijin and Magistrate Dong Chang surrendered Yan City.
translations.idiomatic: Yan City fell to Deng Huaijin and Dong Chang on dingmao.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，渭南雨雹，中人有死者。

translations.literal: jiaxu — Weinan rained hail; some among the people died.
translations.idiomatic: Hail at Weinan killed people on jiaxu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔權罷河北行營，專討淮、蔡。

translations.literal: bingzi — an edict ordered temporarily halting the Hebei field headquarters and focusing on Huai and Cai alone.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei operations were suspended to finish Huai-Cai on bingzi.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，隨唐節度使李愬奏敗賊於吳房，獲賊將李祐。

translations.literal: guisi — Sui-Tang military commissioner Li Su memorialized defeating rebels at Wu Fang and capturing rebel general Li You.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su reported Wu Fang victory and Li You's capture on guisi.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以尚書左丞許孟容為東都留守，充都畿防禦使。

translations.literal: jihai — Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Xu Mengrong was made Eastern Capital regent and metropolitan defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Mengrong became Luoyang regent on jihai.

sentences.zh: 時東畿民戶供軍尤苦，車數千乘相錯於路，牛皆饋軍，民戶多以驢耕。

translations.literal: At the time eastern-capital households supplying the army suffered especially; thousands of carts blocked the roads, oxen all fed to the army, and many households plowed with donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang supply lines were stripped of oxen; farmers plowed with donkeys.

sentences.zh: 己酉，作蓬萊池周廊四百間。

translations.literal: jiyou — four hundred bays of corridor were built around the Pool of Immortals.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred corridor rooms ringed the Pool of Immortals on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 六月己未朔，以衛尉卿程異為鹽鐵使，代王播。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiwei new moon — Weiwei Director Cheng Yi was made salt and iron commissioner, replacing Wang Bo.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi replaced Wang Bo as salt commissioner on jiwei.

sentences.zh: 時異為鹽鐵使副，自江南收拾到供軍錢一百八十五萬以進，故得代播。

translations.literal: At the time Yi was salt deputy; from Jiangnan he had gathered one million eight hundred fifty thousand in army funds and presented them — hence he replaced Bo.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi bought the post with 1.85 million in recovered army funds.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賊吳元濟上表，請束身歸朝。

translations.literal: renxu — rebel Wu Yuanji submitted a memorial asking to bind himself and return to court.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanji petitioned to surrender on renxu.

sentences.zh: 時連破三柵，賊勢迫蹙，實欲歸朝，而制於左右，故不果行。

translations.literal: Having lost three stockades in succession, rebel strength was pressed tight; he truly wished to surrender, but was controlled by his close advisers — therefore it did not happen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji wanted to yield but his staff held him back.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，京師大雨，含元殿一柱傾，市中水深三尺，壞坊民二千家。

translations.literal: yiyou — the capital had great rain; one pillar of Hanyuan Hall tilted; market water three chi deep; two thousand ward households ruined.
translations.idiomatic: A cloudburst flooded markets and shook Hanyuan Hall on yiyou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on wuzi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔以定州饑，募人入粟受官及減選、超資。

translations.literal: renchen — an edict: because Dingzhou was famine-struck, recruit men to enter grain for office and selection benefits, and for reduced examinations and early promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou famine donors could buy office on renchen.

sentences.zh: 河北水災，邢、洺尤甚，平地或深二丈。

translations.literal: Hebei suffered flood disaster; Xing and Ming were worst — in level ground sometimes two zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei floods stood two zhang deep in places.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，戶部尚書于頔請致仕，不允。

translations.literal: jiachen — Revenue Minister Yu Di requested retirement; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Di's retirement plea was denied on jiachen.

sentences.zh: 嶺南節度使崔詠卒。

translations.literal: Lingnan military commissioner Cui Yong died.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yong died as Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，敕：「今後左降官及責授正員官等，宜從到任經五考滿，許量移；

translations.literal: yiyou — an edict: "Hereafter demoted officials and commissioned regular officials should, from assuming post through five completed examinations, be permitted measured transfer;
translations.idiomatic: An edict set five-year terms before demoted officials could transfer;

sentences.zh: 如未滿五考遇恩赦者，從節文處分；

translations.literal: if before five examinations an amnesty occurs, follow the amnesty text;
translations.idiomatic: amnesties before five years would follow their own rules;

sentences.zh: 如犯十惡大逆、贓賄緣坐，奏取進止。

translations.literal: if guilty of the ten abominations, great treason, or corruption with implicated kin, submit for imperial decision."
translations.idiomatic: capital crimes still required imperial approval."

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，以國子祭酒孔戣為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: gengxu — National University Chancellor Kong Zong was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Zong took Lingnan on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，制以中書侍郎、平章事裴度守門下侍郎同平章事、使持節蔡州諸軍事、蔡州刺史，充彰義軍節度、申光蔡觀察處置等使，仍充淮西宣慰處置使。

translations.literal: bingchen — by decree, Chancellery Vice Director and Grand Councillor Pei Du was made concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, holder of the staff for Cai prefecture military affairs, Cai prefect, Zhangyi army military commissioner, Shen-Guang-Cai observation and disposition commissioner, and also Huai-West pacification and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du was sent to command the Zhangyi campaign on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 以朝散大夫、守尚書戶部侍郎、上護軍、賜紫金魚袋崔群為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Miscellaneous Matters, acting Revenue Minister, Upper Guardian General, granted gold-purple fish bag Cui Qun was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Qun joined the council the same day.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎馬總兼御史大夫，充淮西行營諸軍宣慰副使；

translations.literal: Penal Vice Minister Ma Zong was made concurrent Censor-in-Chief and Huai-West field army pacification vice commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zong became Pei Du's deputy commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以太了右庶子韓愈兼御史中丞，充彰義軍行軍司馬；

translations.literal: Crown Prince Right Vice Guardian Han Yu was made concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief and Zhangyi army campaign staff officer;
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu joined the Zhangyi staff;

sentences.zh: 以司勛員外郎李正封、都官員外郎馮宿、禮部員外郎李宗閔皆兼侍御史，為判官書記：從度出征。

translations.literal: Merit Bureau Director Li Zhengfeng, Capital Bureau Director Feng Su, and Rites Bureau Director Li Zongmin were all made concurrent Attending Censors as chief secretaries and recorders — accompanying Du on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhengfeng, Feng Su, and Li Zongmin went as Du's secretaries.

sentences.zh: 詔以郾城為行蔡州治所。

translations.literal: An edict made Yan City the provisional seat of Cai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yan City became the field capital of Cai.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，裴度發赴行營，敕神策軍三百人衛從，上禦通化門勞遣之。

translations.literal: gengshen — Pei Du set out for the field headquarters; three hundred Shence troops were ordered to escort him; the Emperor attended at Tonghua Gate to send him off with labor.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du left for the front with Shence escort on gengshen.

sentences.zh: 度望門再拜，銜涕而辭，上賜之犀帶。

translations.literal: Du looked back at the gate and bowed twice, tears in his mouth as he took leave; the Emperor bestowed a rhinoceros belt.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du wept at the gate and received an imperial rhinoceros belt.

sentences.zh: 以河南尹辛秘為潞府長史、昭義軍節度使，代郗士美。

translations.literal: Henan Intendant Xin Mi was made Lu prefecture senior administrator and Zhaoyi military commissioner, replacing Heshimei.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Mi replaced Heshimei at Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 以士美為工部尚書，孟簡為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Heshimei was made Works Minister; Meng Jian was made Revenue Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Heshimei and Meng Jian were promoted to central posts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以同州刺史張正甫為河南尹。

translations.literal: wuchen — Tongzhou Prefect Zhang Zhengfu was made Henan Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhengfu became Henan Intendant on wuchen.

sentences.zh: 甲申，裴度至郾城。

translations.literal: jiashen — Pei Du reached Yan City.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du arrived at Yan City on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dinghai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on dinghai.

sentences.zh: 戊子，出內庫羅綺、犀玉、金帶之具，送度支估計供軍。

translations.literal: wuzi — inner-store brocade, rhinoceros horn, jade, and gold belts were issued to Revenue for valuation to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial luxuries were liquidated for the campaign on wuzi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，御史臺奏；

translations.literal: jiawu — the Censorate memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate petitioned on jiawu:

sentences.zh: 「同制除官，承前以名字高下為班位先後。

translations.literal: "For officials appointed by the same edict, formerly the sequence of names high and low fixed precedence.
translations.idiomatic: "Concurrent appointees had been ranked by name order,

sentences.zh: 或名在前身在外，及到，卻在舊人之上。

translations.literal: Sometimes the name came first but the person arrived later — on arrival he still ranked above the older appointee.
translations.idiomatic: so late arrivals could leapfrog seniors.

sentences.zh: 今請以上日為先後。

translations.literal: Now request using the appointment date for precedence."
translations.idiomatic: They asked to rank by appointment date instead."

sentences.zh: 」敕曰：「名在前，上日在後，未逾月，不在此限。

translations.literal: An edict said: "If the name is first but the appointment date later, within one month this limit does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ruled name order held for one month after appointment;

sentences.zh: 行立班次，即宜以敕內前後為定。

translations.literal: For standing court order, use the edict's internal sequence as fixed."
translations.idiomatic: then edict order would govern seating."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，劍南東川節度盧坦卒。

translations.literal: wuxu — Eastern Sichuan military commissioner Lu Tan died.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tan died in the east on wuxu.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貶京兆尹竇易直為金州刺史，以鞫獄得贓不實故也。

translations.literal: jihai — Capital Intendant Dou Yizhi was demoted to Jinzhou prefect for judging a case and obtaining a false confession of bribery.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Yizhi was exiled for a coerced confession on jihai.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以御史中丞為京兆尹。

translations.literal: xinchou — the Vice Censor-in-Chief was made Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: The vice censor became Capital Intendant on xinchou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以湖南觀察使韋貫之為太子詹事分司。

translations.literal: renyin — Hunan observation commissioner Wei Guanzhi was made Crown Prince Household Administrator in absentia.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guanzhi was sidelined to the heir's household on renyin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以刑部郎中知雜崔元略為御史中丞。

translations.literal: yisi — Penal Bureau Director acting miscellaneous matters Cui Yuanlue was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuanlue became censor-in-chief on yisi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以朝議大夫、門下侍郎、同平章事李逢吉檢校兵部尚書、使持節梓州諸軍事、梓州刺史，充劍南東川節度副大使，知節度事。

translations.literal: dingwei — Court Discussion Doctor, Chancellery Vice Director, Grand Councillor Li Fengji was made acting War Minister, holder of the staff for Zizhou military affairs, Zizhou prefect, and Eastern Sichuan military vice commissioner in charge of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fengji was sent to Sichuan on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以撫州刺史袁滋為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: gengzi — Fuzhou Prefect Yuan Zi was made Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi returned to Hunan as observer on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，裴度往沲口觀板築五溝，賊遽至，注弩挺刃將及度，面李光顏，田布扼其歸路，大敗之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renshen — Pei Du went to Mokou to inspect plank construction of the Five Ditches; rebels suddenly arrived, strung crossbows and drew blades almost reaching Du; Li Guangyan and Tian Bu blocked their retreat and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du nearly died inspecting ditches when rebels struck on renshen.

sentences.zh: 是日，度幾陷。

translations.literal: That day Du nearly fell captive.
translations.idiomatic: He barely escaped capture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，內出《元和辯謗略》三卷付史館。

translations.literal: guiyou — from within, the Yuanhe "Discerning Slander" in three scrolls was issued to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent the Yuanhe slander reader to the historians on guiyou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以淮南節度使、檢校左僕射李鄘為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，以左丞衛次公代鄘為淮南節度使。

translations.literal: jiashen — Huainan military commissioner, acting Left Vice Director Li Yong was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor; Left Vice Director Wei Cigong replaced Yong as Huainan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yong entered the council; Wei Cigong took Huainan on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 己卯、隨、唐節度使李愬率師入蔡州，執吳元濟以獻，淮西平。

translations.literal: jimao — Sui-Tang military commissioner Li Su led troops into Cai prefecture, seized Wu Yuanji and presented him; Huai-West was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su captured Wu Yuanji in Cai City on jimao; Huai-West fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申詔：「淮西立功將出，委韓弘、裴度條疏奏聞。

translations.literal: jiashen edict: "Huai-West merit officers are coming out; entrust Han Hong and Pei Du to list and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on jiashen ordered Han Hong and Pei Du to report Huai merit rolls;

sentences.zh: 淮西軍人，一切不問。

translations.literal: Huai-West soldiers — none are to be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: no Huai soldier was to be prosecuted;

sentences.zh: 宜準元敕給復二年。

translations.literal: Grant tax remission for two years per the original edict."
translations.idiomatic: and the region received two years' tax relief."

translations.literal: The edict closed."
translations.idiomatic: That closed the Huai-West amnesty edict.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌朔，御興安門受淮西之俘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingxu new moon — at Xing'an Gate the Emperor received the Huai-West captives.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong took the Huai captives at Xing'an Gate on bingxu.

sentences.zh: 以吳元濟徇兩市，斬於獨柳樹；

translations.literal: Wu Yuanji was paraded through both markets and beheaded at the Lone Willow Tree;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanji was executed at Lone Willow after a public parade;

sentences.zh: 妻沈氏，沒入掖庭；

translations.literal: his wife Lady Shen was confiscated into the inner palace;
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shen went to the palace workshops;

sentences.zh: 弟二人、子三人，配流，尋誅之；

translations.literal: two younger brothers and three sons were exiled — soon executed;
translations.idiomatic: his kin were exiled and then killed;

sentences.zh: 判官劉協等七人處斬。

translations.literal: seven staff officers including Chief Secretary Liu Xie were executed.
translations.idiomatic: seven aides including Liu Xie were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 錄平淮西功：隨唐節度使、檢校左散騎常侍李愬檢校尚書左僕射、襄州刺史，充山南東道節度、襄鄧隨唐復郢均房等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: Recording pacification of Huai-West merit: Sui-Tang military commissioner, acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant Li Su was made acting Left Vice Director, Xiangzhou prefect, and Shannan East military commissioner with observation over Xiang, Deng, Sui, Tang, Fu, E, Jun, and Fang;
translations.idiomatic: Li Su was richly rewarded with the Shannan East command;

sentences.zh: 加宣武軍節度使韓弘兼侍中；

translations.literal: Xuanwu military commissioner Han Hong was given concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Han Hong received a palace title;

sentences.zh: 忠武軍節度使李光顏、河陽節度使烏重胤並檢校司空。

translations.literal: Zhongwu military commissioner Li Guangyan and Heyang military commissioner Wu Zhongyin were both made acting Masters of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan and Wu Zhongyin were made honorary works ministers.

sentences.zh: 以宣武軍都虞候韓公武檢校左散騎常侍、鄜坊丹延節度使，以魏博行營兵馬使田布為右金吾衛將軍，皆賞破賊功也。

translations.literal: Xuanwu army chief adjutant Han Gongwu was made acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant and Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan military commissioner; Weibo field army horse commander Tian Bu was made Right Golden Guard general — all rewarded for breaking rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Han Gongwu and Tian Bu were promoted for the victory.

sentences.zh: 甲午，恩王連薨。

translations.literal: jiawu — Prince En died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince En died on jiawu.

sentences.zh: 以蔡州郾城為溵，析上蔡、西平、遂平三縣隸焉。

translations.literal: Cai prefecture's Yan City was made Yin prefecture; Shangcai, Xiping, and Suiping three counties were attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: Yan City became Yin prefecture with three counties.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以淮西宣慰副使、門下侍郎、同平章事裴度守本官，賜上柱國、晉國公、食邑三千戶；

translations.literal: wushen — Huai-West pacification vice commissioner, Chancellery Vice Director, Grand Councillor Pei Du kept his post, was granted Upper Pillar of State, Duke of Jin with three thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du was ennobled Duke of Jin on wushen;

sentences.zh: 以蔡州留後馬總檢校工部尚書、蔡州刺史、彰義軍節度使、溵州潁陳許節度使。

translations.literal: Cai acting prefect Ma Zong was made acting Works Minister, Cai prefect, Zhangyi military commissioner, and Yin-Fuying-Chen-Xu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zong took the Zhangyi and Yin commands.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以右庶子韓愈為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: bingzi — Right Vice Guardian Han Yu was made Penal Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu became penal vice minister on bingzi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南、河北水。

translations.literal: That year Henan and Hebei flooded.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck Henan and Hebei that year.

sentences.zh: 元和十三年十三年春正月己酉朔，御含元殿受朝賀，禮畢，御丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 13 — spring, first month, jiyou new moon: at Hanyuan Hall the Emperor received New Year congratulations; when rites ended, he ascended Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 13 opened with audience and empire-wide amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以文宣王三十八代孫孔惟晊襲文宣公。

translations.literal: jichou — Kong Weizhi, thirty-eighth-generation descendant of the Duke of Culture, inherited the title Duke of Culture.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius' line received the hereditary dukedom on jichou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕李師道頻獻表章，披露懇誠，宜令諫議大夫張宿往彼宣慰。

translations.literal: gengyin — an edict: Li Shidao has repeatedly submitted memorials revealing earnest sincerity — Remonstrating Doctor Zhang Su should be sent there to proclaim comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Su was dispatched to reassure Li Shidao on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以禮部尚書王播為成都尹、劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: xinchai — Rites Minister Wang Bo was made Chengdu Intendant and Western Sichuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo went west as Sichuan commissioner on xinchai.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，御麟德殿，宴群臣，大合樂，凡三日而罷，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: Second month, yihai — at Linde Hall the Emperor feasted the hundred officials with great music for three days, then dismissed; gifts were graded.
translations.idiomatic: A three-day victory feast filled Linde Hall in the second month.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，以前劍南西川節度使李夷簡為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin — former Western Sichuan commissioner Li Yijian was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yijian became chief censor on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 兩丙，以同州刺史鄭絪為東都留守、都畿汝防禦使。

translations.literal: bingyin — Tongzhou Prefect Zheng Qian was made Eastern Capital regent and metropolitan Yu defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qian became Luoyang regent on bingyin.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以御史大夫李夷簡為門下侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: gengzi — Censor-in-Chief Li Yijian was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yijian entered the council on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 宰相李鄘守戶部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Li Yong kept the Revenue Ministry and ceased handling administration.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yong left the council but kept Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以太子少師鄭餘慶為左僕射。

translations.literal: dingwei — Crown Prince Junior Tutor Zheng Yuqing was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yuqing became left vice director on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔：「百司職田，多少不均，為弊日久，宜令逐司各收職田草粟都數，自長官以下，除留闕官物外分給。

translations.literal: xinchai — an edict: "Official duty fields of the hundred offices, more or less unequal, have long been a abuse — order each office to gather total duty-field grain and grass, and from the chief down, apart from retained vacant-office goods, distribute to all."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered fairer sharing of official duty-field harvests.

sentences.zh: 」至銀臺待罪，請獻德、棣二州，兼入管內租稅。

translations.literal: At Silver Terrace he awaited punishment, asking to offer De and Di prefectures and their taxes within his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: A minister offered two prefectures to atone at court.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前東都留守許孟容卒。

translations.literal: renxu — former Eastern Capital regent Xu Mengrong died.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Mengrong died on renxu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔復王承宗官爵。

translations.literal: gengchen — an edict restored Wang Chengzong's offices and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong's rank was restored on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 以華州刺史鄭權為德州刺史、橫海軍節度、德棣滄景等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Hua Prefect Zheng Quan was made Dezhou prefect, Transocean military commissioner, and observer over De, Di, Cang, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Quan took the Transocean command.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，鳳翔節度使李惟簡卒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yiyou — Fengxiang military commissioner Li Weijian died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Weijian died in Fengxiang on yiyou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月近心後星。

translations.literal: yiwei — the moon drew near the rear Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: The moon neared the rear Heart star on yiwei.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以忠武軍節度使李光顏為滑州刺史、義成軍節度使，以彰義軍節度使馬總為許州刺史、忠武軍節度使、陳許溵蔡觀察使。

translations.literal: bingchen — Zhongwu military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Hua prefect and Yicheng military commissioner; Zhangyi military commissioner Ma Zong was made Xu prefect, Zhongwu military commissioner, and Chen-Xu-Yin-Cai observer.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan and Ma Zong swapped central China commands on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以山南東道節度使李愬為鳳翔尹、鳳翔隴右節度使，辛丑，知渤海國務大仁秀檢校秘書監、忽汗州都督，冊為渤海國王。

translations.literal: wuxu — Shannan East military commissioner Li Su was made Fengxiang Intendant and Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner; xinchou — Parhae state affairs director Da Renxiu was made acting Palace Secretary Supervisor and Khitan Prefecture Protector-General and enfeoffed King of Parhae.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su went to Fengxiang; Parhae's king was enfeoffed on xinchou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以戶部侍郎孟簡檢校工部尚書、襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: bingwu — Revenue Vice Minister Meng Jian was made acting Works Minister, Xiangzhou prefect, and Shannan East military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Jian took Shannan East on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guichou new moon — there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: An eclipse marked the sixth-month opening.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，湖南觀察使袁滋卒。

translations.literal: yichou — Hunan observation commissioner Yuan Zi died.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi died in Hunan on yichou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以滄景節程權為邠州刺史、邠寧節度使。

translations.literal: dingchou — Cang-Jing commissioner Cheng Quan was made Bin prefect and Binning military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Quan took Binning on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 出內庫絹三十萬匹、錢三十萬貫，付度支供軍。

translations.literal: Thirty myriad bolts of inner-store silk and thirty myriad strings were issued to Revenue to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: Inner silk and cash funded the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，以新除鳳翔節度使李愬為徐州刺史、武寧軍節度使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guiwei — newly appointed Fengxiang commissioner Li Su was made Xuzhou prefect and Wuning military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su was shifted to Wuning on guiwei.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以田弘正檢校司空。

translations.literal: jiashen — Tian Hongzheng was made acting Master of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Hongzheng received an honorary works title on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔削奪淄青節度使李師道在身官爵，仍令宣武、魏博、義成、武寧、橫海等五鎮之師，分路進討。

translations.literal: yiyou — an edict stripped Ziqing military commissioner Li Shidao of all offices and titles in his person, and ordered Xuanwu, Weibo, Yicheng, Wuning, and Transocean armies to advance on separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shidao was outlawed and five armies marched on Ziqing on yiyou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以門下侍郎、同平章事李夷簡檢校左僕射、同平章事、揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: xinchou — Chancellery Vice Director, Grand Councillor Li Yijian was made acting Left Vice Director, Grand Councillor, Yangzhou metropolitan senior administrator, and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yijian went south to Huainan on xinchou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔諸道節度使先帶度支營田使名者，並罷之。

translations.literal: jiyou — an edict: wherever circuit military commissioners also bore revenue or garrison-farm commissioner titles, all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit revenue and garrison-farm titles were stripped on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以左僕射鄭餘慶為鳳翔隴右節度使。

translations.literal: gengxu — Left Vice Director Zheng Yuqing was made Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yuqing took Fengxiang on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，以中書侍郎平章事王涯為兵部侍郎，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renzi — Chancellery Vice Director and Grand Councillor Wang Ya was made War Vice Minister and ceased handling administration.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ya left the council on renzi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以尚書右丞崔從為興元尹、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: wuwu — Right Vice Director of the Department Cui Cong was made Xingyuan Intendant and Shannan West military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Cong took Shannan West on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白近左執法。

translations.literal: jiaxu — Venus drew near the Left Enforcer star.
translations.idiomatic: Venus neared the Left Enforcer on jiaxu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，敕應同司官有大功已上親者，但非連判及勾檢之官並官長，則不在回避改換之限。

translations.literal: yihai — an edict: where officials of the same office have parents or elders in great mourning, except for linked judges and auditing officers and the office chief, they are not within the limit of avoidance and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: An edict narrowed kinship avoidance rules on yihai.

sentences.zh: 時刑部員外郎楊嗣復以父於陵除戶部侍郎，遂以近例避嫌，請出省，不從，因有是敕。

translations.literal: At the time Penal Bureau Director Yang Sifu's father, on mourning leave from Yuling, was made Revenue Vice Minister; following recent precedent for avoidance, he asked to leave the ministry and was not permitted — hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sifu's forced stay prompted the clarification.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，木、金、水、三宿聚於軫。

translations.literal: dingchou — Wood, Metal, and Water three mansions gathered at Axle.
translations.idiomatic: Three mansions piled at Axle on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，前山南西道節度使權德輿卒。

translations.literal: wuyin — former Shannan West military commissioner Quan Deyu died.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Deyu died on wuyin.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，以左衛將軍高霞寓為單于大都護，、振武麟勝節度使。

translations.literal: jiashen — Left Guard General Gao Xiayu was made Chanyu Protector-General and Zhenwu-Linsheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xiayu took the northern frontier on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以戶部侍郎、判度支皇甫鎛同中書門下平章事，依前判度支。

translations.literal: jiachen — Revenue Vice Minister and acting revenue commissioner Huangfu Bo was made Grand Councillor, continuing to act for revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Bo entered the council while keeping Revenue on jiachen.

sentences.zh: 以衛尉卿充諸道鹽鐵轉運使程異為工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事，依前充使。

translations.literal: Weiwei Director and salt-iron transport commissioner Cheng Yi was made Works Vice Minister and Grand Councillor, continuing as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi joined the council and kept salt transport.

sentences.zh: 是時，上切於財賦，故用聚斂之臣居相位。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor was urgent about finances — hence revenue-minded men were placed in the council.
translations.idiomatic: Fiscal hardliners took the premiership for money.

sentences.zh: 詔下，群情驚駭，宰臣裴度、崔群極諫，不納。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, public sentiment was shocked and alarmed; councillors Pei Du and Cui Qun remonstrated strongly — not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du and Cui Qun protested in vain.

sentences.zh: 二人請退。

translations.literal: The two men requested withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Both offered to resign.

sentences.zh: 熒惑近哭星。

translations.literal: Mars drew near the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: Mars approached the Weeping star.

sentences.zh: 丁未，出內庫絹十萬匹給東軍。

translations.literal: dingwei — one hundred thousand bolts of inner-store silk were issued to the eastern army.
translations.idiomatic: Silk was rushed to the eastern front on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，吐蕃寇宥州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiayin — Tibet raided You prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet hit You on jiayin.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，靈武奏破吐蕃二萬於定遠城。

translations.literal: renxu — Lingwu reported breaking twenty thousand Tibetans at Dingyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu claimed a twenty-thousand-man victory on renxu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，前淮南節度使衛次公卒。

translations.literal: guihai — former Huainan military commissioner Wei Cigong died.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Cigong died on guihai.

sentences.zh: 甲子，平涼鎮遏兵馬使郝玼奏收復原州，破吐蕃二萬。

translations.literal: jiazi — Pingliang frontier suppression horse commander Hao Qi memorialized recovering Yuan prefecture and breaking twenty thousand Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Qi reported retaking Yuanzhou on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月近昴。

translations.literal: That night the moon drew near the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: The moon neared Mao that night.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以左金吾衛大將軍薛平檢校刑部尚書、滑州刺史，充義成軍節度使；

translations.literal: bingzi — Left Golden Guard Grand General Xue Ping was made acting Penal Minister and Hua prefect, Yicheng military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ping took Yicheng on bingzi;

sentences.zh: 以義成軍節度使李光顏為許州刺史，充忠武軍節度使、陳許觀察等使。

translations.literal: Yicheng military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Xu prefect, Zhongwu military commissioner, and Chen-Xu observer.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan moved to Zhongwu at Xu.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳朔，夏州破吐蕃五萬。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinsi new moon — Xiazhou broke fifty thousand Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazhou reported routing fifty thousand Tibetans on xinsi.

sentences.zh: 靈武奏攻破吐蕃長樂州羅城。

translations.literal: Lingwu memorialized breaking the outer wall of Tibet's Changle prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu took Changle's outer wall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以山人柳泌為臺州刺史，為上於天臺山採仙藥故也。

translations.literal: dinghai — the mountain man Liu Bi was made Taizhou prefect for gathering immortal drugs on Tiantai for the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Alchemist Liu Bi was made Taizhou prefect on dinghai.

sentences.zh: 制下，諫官論之，不納。

translations.literal: When the decree was issued, remonstrating officials debated it — not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Censors protested the alchemist appointment in vain.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以河陽節度使鳥重胤為滄州刺史、橫海軍節度、滄景德棣觀察等使。

translations.literal: renyin — Heyang military commissioner Wu Zhongyin was made Cangzhou prefect, Transocean military commissioner, and observer over Cang, Jing, De, and Di.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhongyin took Transocean on renyin.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以華州刺史令狐楚為懷州刺史，充河陽三城、懷、孟節度使。

translations.literal: dingwei — Hua Prefect Linghu Chu was made Huai prefect and Heyang Three Cities, Huai, and Meng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Chu took Heyang on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，敕左右龍武軍六軍及威遠營應納課戶共一千八百人衣糧並停，仍付府縣收管。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinhai — an edict: the Left and Right Dragon Martial Six Armies and Weiyuan Camp corvée households, one thousand eight hundred persons' clothing and grain, all halted — still delivered to prefecture and county control.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée rations for palace guards were cut on xinhai.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，軍前擒到李師道將夏侯澄等四十七人，詔並釋付魏博及義成軍收管，要還賊中者，則量事優給放還。

translations.literal: wuyin — forty-seven men including Li Shidao's general Xia Houcheng were captured before the army; an edict released them to Weibo and Yicheng for custody; those wishing to return to the rebels were generously sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Captured Ziqing officers were freed to encourage defections on wuyin.

sentences.zh: 上顧謂宰臣曰：「人臣事君，但力行善事，自致公望，何乃好樹朋黨。

translations.literal: The Emperor looked at the councillors and said: "Ministers serving the ruler need only strive to do good — fame comes of itself — why delight in forming factions?"
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong warned his ministers against faction-making.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「他人之言，亦與卿等相似，豈易辯之哉？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Others' words are also like yours — how easy to distinguish?"
translations.idiomatic: He admitted slander was hard to tell apart.

sentences.zh: 」度曰：「君子小人，觀其所行，當自區別矣。

translations.literal: Du said: "Gentleman and petty man — watch their conduct and they distinguish themselves."
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du said deeds reveal the man.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「凡好事口說則易，躬行則難。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Whatever is easy to say with the mouth is hard to carry out in person.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong said talk is cheap.

sentences.zh: 卿等即言之，須行之，勿空口說。

translations.literal: You speak — you must act; do not empty talk."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered ministers to match words with deeds."

sentences.zh: 」度等謝曰：「陛下處分，可謂至矣，臣等敢不激勵。

translations.literal: Du and the others thanked him: "Your Majesty's handling can be called utmost — we dare not fail to be stirred.
translations.idiomatic: The council thanked him and vowed effort;

sentences.zh: 然天下之人，從陛下所行，不從陛下所言，臣等亦願陛下每言之則行之。

translations.literal: Yet all under Heaven follow what Your Majesty does, not what Your Majesty says — we also wish Your Majesty whenever you speak then to act."
translations.idiomatic: they begged him to rule by example, not edict alone."

sentences.zh: 」上頗欣納。

translations.literal: The Emperor was quite pleased to accept it.
translations.idiomatic: He took the rebuke well.

sentences.zh: 是歲，回紇、南詔蠻、渤海、高麗、吐蕃、奚、契丹、訶陵國並朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Uighurs, Nanzhao, Parhae, Koguryo, Tibet, Xi, Khitan, and Heling all paid court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Many foreign states sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 元和十四年十四年春正月庚辰朔，以東師宿野，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Yuanhe 14 — spring, first month, gengchen new moon: because eastern troops camped in the wild, New Year congratulations were not received.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe 14 opened without audience while armies were in the field.

sentences.zh: 壬午，復置仗內教坊於延政里。

translations.literal: renwu — the inner palace teaching workshop was restored at Yanzheng Lane.
translations.idiomatic: The inner music school returned on renwu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥徐州軍破賊二萬於金鄉。

translations.literal: dinghai — Xuzhou army broke twenty thousand rebels at Jinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wuning troops won at Jinxiang on dinghai.

sentences.zh: 迎鳳翔法門寺佛骨至京師，留禁中三日，乃送詣寺，王公士庶奔走舍施如不及。

translations.literal: Welcoming Fengxiang Famen Temple Buddha relics to the capital — three days in the inner palace, then sent to the temple; nobles and commoners rushed to give alms as if they could not keep pace.
translations.idiomatic: Buddha relics from Famen set off a donation frenzy in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎韓愈上疏極陳其弊。

translations.literal: Penal Vice Minister Han Yu memorialized strongly stating the harm.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu denounced the relic cult in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，貶愈為潮州刺史。

translations.literal: guisi — Yu was demoted to Chaozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu was exiled to Chaozhou on guisi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，魏博軍破賊五萬於東阿。

translations.literal: bingchen — Weibo army broke fifty thousand rebels at Dong'e.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo routed rebels at Dong'e on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，斬前滄州刺史李宗奭於獨柳樹。

translations.literal: xinsi — former Cangzhou Prefect Li Zongshi was beheaded at the Lone Willow Tree.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongshi was executed on xinsi.

sentences.zh: 朝廷初除鄭權滄州，宗奭拒詔不受代，既而為三軍所逐，乃入朝，故誅之。

translations.literal: The court had first appointed Zheng Quan to Cangzhou; Zongshi refused the edict and would not yield — later the three armies drove him out and he entered court — hence execution.
translations.idiomatic: He had resisted Zheng Quan's appointment until the army expelled him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯夜，月近南斗魁。

translations.literal: guimao night — the moon drew near the southern Dipper's leader.
translations.idiomatic: The moon neared the Dipper leader on guimao night.

sentences.zh: 丙午，魏博軍破賊萬人於陽谷。

translations.literal: bingwu — Weibo army broke ten thousand rebels at Yanggu.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo won again at Yanggu on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉朔，以商州刺史嚴謨為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: Second month, jiyou new moon — Shang Prefect Yan Mo was made Qianzhong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Mo took Qianzhong on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，敕淄青行營諸軍，所至收下城邑，不得妄行傷殺，及焚燒廬舍，掠奪民財，開發墳墓，宜嚴加止絕。

translations.literal: yimao — an edict to Ziqing field armies: wherever cities are taken, do not rashly kill, burn houses, plunder people's goods, or open graves — strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqing troops were ordered to spare civilians on yimao.

sentences.zh: 以鎮、冀水災，賜王承宗綾絹萬匹。

translations.literal: Because Zhen and Ji suffered flood disaster, ten thousand bolts of silk were granted Wang Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong received flood relief silk.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，襄陽節度使孟簡舉鄖鄉鎮遏使趙潔為鄖鄉縣令，有虧常式，罰一月俸料。

translations.literal: xinyou — Xiangyang commissioner Meng Jian nominated Zhenxiang frontier commander Zhao Jie as Zhenxiang magistrate, violating regular form — fined one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Jian was fined for an irregular magistrate appointment.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，田弘正奏，今月九日，淄青都知兵馬使劉悟斬李師道並男二人首請降，師道所管十二州平。

translations.literal: renxu — Tian Hongzheng memorialized: this month on the ninth day, Ziqing chief army commander Liu Wu beheaded Li Shidao and two sons' heads and asked to surrender; the twelve prefectures Shidao held were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wu killed Li Shidong and surrendered Ziqing on renxu.

sentences.zh: 甲了，上御宣政殿受賀。

translations.literal: jiazi — the Emperor attended Xuanzheng Hall to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Court celebrated Ziqing's fall at Xuanzheng on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上御興安門受田弘正所獻賊俘，群臣賀於樓下。

translations.literal: jisi — at Xing'an Gate the Emperor received captives Tian Hongzheng presented; officials congratulated below the tower.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Hongzheng presented prisoners at Xing'an on jisi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，制以淄青兵馬使、金紫光錄大夫、試殿中監、兼監察御史劉悟檢校工部尚書、滑州刺史，充義成軍節度使，封彭城郡王，食邑三千戶，賜錢二萬貫、莊宅各一區。

translations.literal: gengwu — by decree, Ziqing army commander, Gold-purple Grand Mentor, acting Palace Director, concurrent Investigating Censor Liu Wu was made acting Works Minister, Hua prefect, and Yicheng military commissioner; enfeoffed Prince of Pengcheng with three thousand households; granted twenty thousand strings, one manor and one estate.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wu was enfeoffed and sent to Yicheng on gengwu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，田弘正加檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: guiyou — Tian Hongzheng was given concurrent Master of Works and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Hongzheng entered the council on guiyou.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯朔。

translations.literal: Third month, jimao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The third month opened on jimao.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上以齊、魯初平，宴群臣於麟德殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: dingyou — because Qi and Lu were newly pacified, the Emperor feasted the hundred officials at Linde Hall; gifts were graded.
translations.idiomatic: A Linde feast marked the Shandong victory on dingyou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以華州刺史馬總鄆、濮、曹等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: wuzi — Hua Prefect Ma Zong was made observer over Yan, Pu, and Cao;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zong took the Yan-Pu-Cao command;

sentences.zh: 己丑，以義成軍節度使薛平為青州刺史，充平盧軍節度、淄青齊登萊等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: jichou — Yicheng military commissioner Xue Ping was made Qing prefect and Pinglu military commissioner with observation over Zi, Qing, Qi, Deng, Lai;
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ping received Pinglu on jichou;

sentences.zh: 以淄青四面行營供軍使王遂為沂州刺史，充沂、海、兗、密等州都團練觀察等使：析李師道所據十二州為三鎮也。

translations.literal: Ziqing four-side field army supply commissioner Wang Sui was made Yi prefect and observer over Yi, Hai, Yan, and Mi — dividing the twelve prefectures Li Shidao had held into three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sui took Yi while Shidao's twelve prefectures were split three ways.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，浙西觀察使李翛卒。

translations.literal: gengyin — Western Zhe observation commissioner Li Xiao died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiao died in Zhexi on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李師道妻魏氏並男沒入掖庭，堂弟師賢師智、侄弘巽配流。

translations.literal: xinmao — Li Shidao's wife Lady Wei and sons were confiscated into the inner palace; cousins Shixian and Shizhi and nephew Hongyi were exiled.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao's family was punished on xinmao.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以中書舍人衛中行華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: yiwei — Secretariat Drafter Wei Zhongxing was made Hua Prefect, Tong Pass defense, and Zhenguo army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhongxing took Hua and Tong Pass on yiwei.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上顧謂宰臣曰：「聽受之間，大是難事。

translations.literal: xinchou — the Emperor looked at the councillors and said: "Between listening and accepting, it is greatly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong told his ministers that hearing truth was hard.

sentences.zh: 推誠選任，所謂委寄，必合盡心；

translations.literal: Choosing men in good faith and entrusting them — that is called commission — they must give their whole hearts;
translations.idiomatic: Appointment required wholehearted service,

sentences.zh: 及至所行，臨事不無偏黨。

translations.literal: yet when it comes to action, in affairs there is never lack of partiality.
translations.idiomatic: yet officials still played favorites in office.

sentences.zh: 朕臨御已來，歲月斯久，雖不明不敏，然漸見物情，每於行為，務欲詳審。

translations.literal: Since I began ruling, years have grown long; though not bright or keen, I gradually see human feelings, and in conduct I strive for careful scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: He claimed growing insight despite modest self-appraisal.

sentences.zh: 比令學士集前代昧政之事，為《辯謗略》，每欲披閱，以為鑒誡耳。

translations.literal: Recently I ordered academicians to gather past dynasties' obscure-government cases into the "Discerning Slander," which I wish to read often as a mirror and warning."
translations.idiomatic: He cited the Yuanhe slander reader as his moral guidebook.

sentences.zh: 」崔群對曰：「無情曲直，辯之至易；

translations.literal: Cui Qun replied: "Without feeling, straight and crooked are easiest to distinguish;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Qun said open cases are easy,

sentences.zh: 稍懷欺詐，審之實難。

translations.literal: with a little deceit in the heart, scrutiny is truly hard.
translations.idiomatic: but fraud makes judgment hard.

sentences.zh: 故孔子有眾好眾惡之論，浸潤膚受之說，蓋以曖昧難辯故也。

translations.literal: Hence Confucius had the theory of many likes and many dislikes, and of slander that soaks the skin — because ambiguity is hard to judge.
translations.idiomatic: He quoted Confucius on mob opinion and whispered slander.

sentences.zh: 若擇賢而任之，待之以誠，糾之以法，則人自歸公，孰敢行偽？

translations.literal: If the worthy are chosen and entrusted, treated with sincerity, and corrected by law, men will return to the public good — who would dare act falsely?
translations.idiomatic: Honest appointment and law, he said, would end deceit.

sentences.zh: 陛下詳觀載籍，以廣聰明，實天下幸甚。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's close reading of the records to broaden intelligence is the empire's great fortune."
translations.idiomatic: He praised the emperor's historical reading."

sentences.zh: 」以撫州司馬令狐通為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: Fuzhou adjutant Linghu Tong was made Right Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Tong was made Right Guard general.

sentences.zh: 給事中崔植封還制書，言通前刺史壽州，用兵失律，未宜獎用。

translations.literal: Drafting Attendant Cui Zhi returned the edict, saying Tong had formerly been Shou prefect and lost discipline in using troops — not fit for reward.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhi blocked Tong's promotion for a military failure.

sentences.zh: 上令宰臣諭植，以通父彰有功，不忍遂棄其子，其制方行。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered councillors to explain to Zhi that Tong's father Zhang had merit — unwilling to abandon the son outright — the edict proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: The throne overruled Cui Zhi for the father's service.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wushen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened on wushen.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白順行近東井。

translations.literal: yimao — Venus moved direct and drew near the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus marched toward the Eastern Well on yimao.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以刑部尚書李願為鳳翔尹，充鳳翔、隴右節度使。

translations.literal: wuwu — Penal Minister Li Yuan was made Fengxiang Intendant and Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuan took Fengxiang on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔：「諸道節度、都團練、防禦、經等使所管支郡，除本軍州外，別置鎮遏、守捉、兵馬者，並合屬刺史。

translations.literal: bingyin — an edict: "For all circuit military commissioners, regimental training, defense, and disposition commissioners — subordinate prefectures apart from the home army prefecture, wherever separate suppression, garrison, or horse commands are set up, all shall belong to the prefect.
translations.idiomatic: An edict centralized sub-prefecture troops under civil prefects;

sentences.zh: 如刺史帶本州團練、防禦、鎮遏等使，其兵馬額便隸此使。

translations.literal: If the prefect also bears regimental training, defense, or suppression titles for the home prefecture, the horse quota follows that commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: prefects with military titles kept their own quotas;

sentences.zh: 如無別使，即屬軍事。

translations.literal: If there is no separate commissioner, they belong to the military adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: otherwise troops fell to the circuit adjutant.

sentences.zh: 其有邊於溪洞連接蕃蠻之處，特建城鎮，不關州郡者，不在此限。

translations.literal: Where on the frontier brooks and caves connect to southern barbarians special walled towns are built unrelated to prefectures, they are outside this limit."
translations.idiomatic: Frontier forts on tribal borders were exempt."

sentences.zh: 」辛未，工部侍郎、同平章事、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使程異卒。

translations.literal: xinwei — Works Vice Minister, Grand Councillor, and salt-iron transport commissioner Cheng Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi died on xinwei.

sentences.zh: 丙子，制金紫光錄大夫、門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，兼弘文館大學士、上柱國、晉國公、食邑三千戶裴度可檢校左僕射，兼門下侍郎、平章事、太原尹、北都留守，充河東節度、觀察、處置等使。

translations.literal: bingzi — by decree, Gold-purple Grand Mentor, Chancellery Vice Director, Grand Councillor, concurrent Hongwen University Chancellor, Upper Pillar, Duke of Jin with three thousand households Pei Du was made acting Left Vice Director, concurrent Chancellery Vice Director, Grand Councillor, Taiyuan Intendant, Northern Capital regent, and Hedong military observation and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du was sent to Hedong on bingzi.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅朔，以刑部侍郎柳公綽充鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuyin new moon — Penal Vice Minister Liu Gongchuo was made salt-iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gongchuo took salt transport on wuyin.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以楚州刺史李聽為夏州刺史、夏綏銀宥等州節度使。

translations.literal: gengchen — Chuzhou Prefect Li Ting was made Xia prefect and Xia-Sui-Yin-You military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ting took the northwest on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以河東節度使、檢校吏部尚書、同平章事張弘靖為吏部尚書；

translations.literal: bingxu — Hedong military commissioner, acting Personnel Minister, Grand Councillor Zhang Hongjing was made Personnel Minister;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongjing entered central Personnel on bingxu;

sentences.zh: 以忠武軍節度使李光顏為邠、寧、慶節度使，仍以忠武軍六千人赴鎮。

translations.literal: Zhongwu military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Bin-Ning-Qing military commissioner, still taking six thousand Zhongwu troops to the post.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan marched six thousand men to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以工部尚書郗士美檢校刑部尚書、許州刺史，充忠武軍節度使。

translations.literal: gengyin — Works Minister Heshimei was made acting Penal Minister, Xu prefect, and Zhongwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Heshimei took Zhongwu on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 是夜，月近心大星。

translations.literal: That night the moon drew near the great Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: The moon neared Antares that night.

sentences.zh: 己亥，置臨海監牧，命淮南節度使兼之。

translations.literal: jihai — Linhai pasture supervision was established; the Huainan military commissioner was ordered to hold it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: A Linhai stud farm was placed under Huainan on jihai.

sentences.zh: 敕李師古妻裴氏、女宜娘於鄧州安置，李宗奭妻韋氏放出掖庭：坐李師道族人籍沒，上愍之，宥以輕典。

translations.literal: An edict settled Li Shigu's wife Lady Pei and daughter Lady Yiniang at Dengzhou; Li Zongshi's wife Lady Wei was released from the inner palace: because Li Shidao's clan had been confiscated, the Emperor pitied them and pardoned with light punishment.
